灯光是柔和的自然日光，具有电影般的质感，在主体上产生柔和的高光和真实的阴影。整体氛围高端且注重生活方式。
使用 85mm 镜头拍摄，景深较浅——主体保持锐利聚焦，而背景则呈现平滑、奶油般的散景效果。
纹理高度精细且栩栩如生——包括织物褶皱、肤色、配饰和环境元素。
色彩分级干净现代，对比度微妙，增强了真实感，同时保持了精致的电影基调。
8K 分辨率，超清晰细节，照片级真实感，专业时尚杂志风格，高动态范围，优质构图。

title: 电影级微距玩具摄影：迷你野兽
description: 一个复杂的多段式提示，用于生成电影般的微距玩具摄影场景。其概念涉及数十个相同的微型角色实例，它们在一个巨大的开放漫画书上工作，这本漫画书讲述了它们自己的故事。该提示严格执行形象完整性、特定相机视角（低角度微距、90-100mm 镜头）、浅景深和硬定向照明。
content:
A cinematic macro toy-photography scene of the uploaded reference character multiplied into dozens of miniature identical instances, each actively working on a giant open comic book that tells the story of the same character.
Likeness Integrity (CRITICAL)

All miniature instances must preserve the exact identity of the reference character:

• identical proportions

• exact eye shape, spacing, stylization

• same silhouette and material behavior

• no added features, no face changes, no stylization drift
The comic book artwork must depict the exact same character design language, translated into printed comic style without altering anatomy or facial structure.
Scene Concept & Action
The giant comic book lies open like a construction site of narrative.
Mini characters are scattered across the pages, each performing a specific task:
• some are drawing panels with tiny tools (pens, brushes, stylus-like tools)

• some are painting color into panels

• some are climbing panel borders like scaffolding

• some are inspecting scenes, pointing, directing

• some are physically interacting with the comic world ( lifting panels, stepping into frames)
The scene must feel like they are building their own story in real-time.
Perspective & Composition (MANDATORY)
Camera & Perspective (Corrected)
Low-angle macro shot, camera positioned close to the comic page
Lens: 90–100mm macro (compression, NOT distortion)
• Perspective compression must preserve consistent object scale

• Foreground character appears larger only due to proximity to lens

• No exaggerated wide-angle distortion

• Spatial depth created through distance falloff + focus, not scaling

• The open comic book stretches diagonally into depth

• Panels form strong leading lines across the frame

• Composition is intentionally off-balance, not centered

• Some characters partially cropped by frame edges
Foreground includes blurred ink tools, paper edges, or panel borders creating depth layering
Depth of Field (CRITICAL)
Extremely shallow depth of field
• Primary focal plane: one or two mini characters in the foreground actively working

• Mid-ground characters slightly softer

• Background characters and panels fall into creamy blur
No full-frame sharpness
Focus must guide the viewer toward the “main worker” character
Lighting Doctrine
Hard directional cinematic light from top-left
• sharp shadows cast across comic panels

• subtle rim light separating characters from page

• ink reflections create small specular highlights

• shadows from panel edges create natural depth
No flat lighting
Environment & Surface Detail
Macro-level realism of the comic book:
• visible paper fibers

• ink texture and slight gloss

• subtle imperfections in print

• panel borders slightly raised or embossed
Tiny tools leave micro mar
translatedContent:
一个电影般的微距玩具摄影场景，上传的参考角色被复制成几十个微型相同个体，每个个体都在一本巨大的、讲述着同一角色故事的开放漫画书上积极工作。
形象完整性 (至关重要)

所有微型个体都必须保持参考角色的确切身份：

• 相同的比例

• 精确的眼睛形状、间距、风格化

• 相同的轮廓和材质表现

• 没有额外特征，没有面部变化，没有风格化漂移
漫画书的艺术作品必须描绘完全相同的角色设计语言，以印刷漫画风格呈现，不得改变解剖结构或面部结构。
场景概念与动作
巨大的漫画书像叙事工地一样摊开。
微型角色散布在书页上，每个都在执行特定任务：
• 有些用微型工具（钢笔、画笔、触控笔状工具）绘制画格

• 有些在画格中上色

• 有些像脚手架一样攀爬画格边框

• 有些检查场景，指点，指挥

• 有些与漫画世界进行物理互动（抬起画格，走进画框）
场景必须让人感觉他们正在实时构建自己的故事。
透视与构图 (强制)
相机与透视 (已修正)
低角度微距拍摄，相机靠近漫画书页放置
镜头：90–100mm 微距（压缩，而非畸变）
• 透视压缩必须保持一致的物体比例

• 前景角色仅因靠近镜头而显得较大

• 没有夸张的广角畸变

• 空间深度通过距离衰减 + 焦点创建，而非缩放

• 开放的漫画书对角线延伸至深处

• 画格在画面中形成强烈的引导线

• 构图有意偏离中心，而非居中

• 部分角色被画面边缘部分裁剪
前景包括模糊的墨水工具、纸张边缘或画格边框，营造出深度分层
景深 (至关重要)
极浅的景深
• 主要焦平面：前景中一两个正在积极工作的微型角色

• 中景角色略微柔和

• 背景角色和画格呈现奶油般模糊

没有全画幅锐度
焦点必须引导观众看向“主要工作者”角色
光照原则
左上方硬朗的定向电影光
• 锐利的阴影投射在漫画画格上

• 微妙的轮廓光将角色与页面分离

• 墨水反光形成小的镜面高光

• 画格边缘的阴影创造自然深度
无平光照明
环境与表面细节
漫画书的微观真实感：
• 可见的纸张纤维

• 墨水纹理和轻微光泽

• 印刷中的细微瑕疵

• 画格边框略微凸起或压花
微型工具留下微痕

description: 一个高度详细、超现实的提示，用于生成一张成年女性在高端时尚影棚中的四分之三身长照片，强调使用参考图像以确保角色一致性，并注重灯光、镜头和纹理等具体的摄影细节。拍摄对象身穿一件建筑风格的冰蓝色金属感金银丝礼服。
content:
Create image: Use the attached reference image as a visual guide for the character’s appearance, maintaining strong resemblance to the person in the reference. Preserve key visual traits such as facial structure and overall proportions, while allowing small natural variations typical of real photography. The generated subject should clearly resemble the reference while remaining a natural photographic interpretation.
Aspect Ratio: 3:4.
Shot on a Phase One XF with a Schneider-Kreuznach 80mm f/2.8 LS lens, this hyper-realistic three-quarter length photograph captures an adult woman in a high-fashion studio setting, framed slightly off-center for a natural, candid feel. The subject exhibits a slender and athletic build with a sophisticated weight shift onto her right leg, causing her right hip to rise subtly while her torso is angled 15 degrees to the left. Her right hand rests gracefully on her upper thigh with fingers relaxed and softly curved, while her left arm is bent at a sharp angle with the hand placed higher on the hip, creating a dynamic, non-symmetrical silhouette. Her head is tilted slightly toward her right shoulder, maintaining a captivating and charismatic direct gaze. Her skin is depicted with microscopic detail, showcasing a radiant glass-skin finish with visible pores and a healthy glow on her exposed shoulders and collarbone. Her voluminous dark brown hair is styled in dramatic, cascading curls swept heavily to one side, creating an asymmetrical flow of texture and deep shadows. She wears an architectural couture gown made of shimmering, pleated icy-blue metallic lamé that catches the light along every sharp ridge. The bodice features intricate diagonal pleating and a structured sweetheart neckline, while a massive, fan-like sculptural ruffle erupts from the left shoulder. The skirt includes a wrap-around front with a high thigh-level slit, bordered by vertical cascading ruffles that suggest mid-motion fluidity. Her face is styled with a glamorous evening makeup look consisting of a soft mauve and charcoal smoky eye, sharp winged eyeliner, and defined dark brown brows, finished with a matte taupe lip color. She is adorned with large, tiered drop earrings in a matching matte blue finish. The lighting is professionally executed with a primary softbox from the front-side creating gentle shadows under the jawline and deep, cinematic contrast against a minimalist, dark charcoal grey studio backdrop with a smooth, non-reflective floor. Aspect Ratio 3:4.
translatedContent:

长宽比：3:4。
这张超写实的三分之二身长照片使用 Phase One XF 相机和 Schneider-Kreuznach 80mm f/2.8 LS 镜头拍摄，捕捉了一位成年女性在高级时装影棚中的形象，构图略微偏离中心，营造出自然、随意的感觉。拍摄对象身材苗条、健美，重心优雅地转移到右腿，导致右臀部微微抬起，躯干向左倾斜 15 度。她的右手优雅地放在大腿上部，手指放松并柔和弯曲，而左臂则呈锐角弯曲，手放在臀部较高位置，形成动态、不对称的轮廓。她的头部略微倾向右肩，保持着迷人而富有魅力的直视。她的皮肤细节微观可见，展现出光彩照人的玻璃肌效果，毛孔清晰可见，裸露的肩膀和锁骨散发着健康的光泽。她浓密的深棕色头发造型为戏剧性的瀑布式卷发，大量地扫向一侧，营造出不对称的纹理流动和深邃的阴影。她身穿一件建筑风格的高级定制礼服，由闪闪发光的冰蓝色金属褶皱薄纱制成，在每一道锋利的褶皱上捕捉光线。紧身胸衣采用复杂的斜向褶皱和结构化的心形领口，左肩处绽放着巨大的扇形雕塑荷叶边。裙身包括一个环绕式前襟，带有高至大腿的开衩，边缘是垂直的层叠荷叶边，暗示着运动中的流动感。她的脸部化着迷人的晚妆，包括柔和的紫红色和炭灰色烟熏眼妆、犀利的飞翼眼线和分明的深棕色眉毛，最后搭配哑光灰褐色唇色。她佩戴着一对大型分层垂坠耳环，采用配套的哑光蓝色饰面。灯光布置专业，主柔光箱从前方侧面打光，在下颌线下方营造出柔和的阴影，并在极简主义的深炭灰色影棚背景和光滑、无反射的地板上形成深邃的电影感对比。长宽比 3:4。

content:
Two young women are seen in a playful, nighttime outdoor setting, dressed in coordinated Care Bears inspired outfits. The woman on the left is wearing a fuzzy light blue hooded romper with matching arm warmers and oversized, fluffy leg warmers; she holds a matching blue plush bear and poses with a finger to her lips. Beside her, actress Sadie Sink is dressed in a similar lavender fuzzy outfit with pink accents, featuring a hood with rounded ears. She is smiling broadly with her mouth open, holding a yellow Funshine Bear plushie, and the background shows dark foliage under artificial lighting.

In the second image, 

Two young women are seated on a large, textured magenta beanbag chair, maintaining their whimsical aesthetic. The woman in blue has her eyes closed with a gentle smile, cradling a grumpy-faced blue plush bear. Other on the right, leans toward her companion with a playful expression, sticking her tongue out while wearing a fuzzy lavender paw-glove. Their outfits are highly detailed with "belly badges" a yellow moon for the blue costume and a vibrant rainbow for the purple one, capturing a nostalgic, high-energy party atmosphere.

在第二张图片中，

两位年轻女性坐在一张巨大的、有纹理的洋红色懒人沙发上，保持着她们异想天开的审美风格。穿蓝色衣服的女士闭着眼睛，面带微笑，怀里抱着一只表情不悦的蓝色毛绒熊。右边的另一位女士则俏皮地吐着舌头，戴着一只毛茸茸的淡紫色爪形手套，身体倾向她的同伴。她们的服装细节丰富，带有“肚皮徽章”——蓝色服装上是黄色月亮，紫色服装上是鲜艳的彩虹，营造出一种怀旧、充满活力的派对氛围。

content:
**English Core Prompt:**
Medium close-up shot from a high angle looking down, professional fashion photography of a beautiful young adult East Asian woman with fair skin, long soft black hair, and dark brown almond-shaped eyes. She is reclining on a bed in a three-quarter view pose, head slightly tilted, her left hand gently touching her right cheek. She has a calm, pensive expression, with a soft, distant gaze looking away from the camera. She wears an elegant black form-fitting top with a deep V-neckline, made of intricate floral lace with eyelash trim and scattered glossy sequins, and a single ornate gold earring in her left ear. The setting is a softly lit bedroom at night, against a dark background and a white fluffy comforter. The scene is illuminated by a single, soft, diffused key light from the front-left, casting subtle shadows on the right side of her face and body. Intimate, serene, and moody atmosphere. Photorealistic 8K, ultra detailed, best quality, sharp focus on face, shallow depth of field with soft background blur (bokeh). Shot on Sony A7R IV with an 85mm f/2.2 lens. natural pose, no exaggeration, stick to visible elements only.

**推荐参数:**
--ar 3:4
--style raw

**Negative Prompt:**
blurry, harsh lighting, distorted features, bad anatomy, unnatural pose, watermark, text, oversaturated colors, looking directly at camera

content:
A cinematic fashion portrait of a stylish young man posed confidently before a grand traditional wooden doorway adorned with intricate carvings. He wears a sophisticated off-white kurta featuring delicate gold embroidery, exuding understated luxury. His posture is relaxed yet poised, one hand casually tucked into his pocket while the other adjusts his collar, with a calm, self-assured expression.
He has medium-length wavy dark hair, a neatly groomed beard, and is styled with black rectangular sunglasses, a premium wristwatch, and a bold statement ring.
The scene is illuminated with warm natural light, casting soft shadows that enhance depth and mood. Shot with a shallow depth of field, the subject remains in crisp focus while the richly detailed background gently blurs. The composition carries a festive cultural vibe, inspired by Eid, with elegant golden Arabic calligraphy reading “Eid Mubarak” subtly placed to the side.
Ultra-realistic skin texture, high contrast, cinematic color grading with warm yet moody tones. Captured in professional fashion photography style using an 85mm lens at f/1.8, 8K resolution, highly detailed, photorealistic finish.

一幅电影般的时尚肖像，一位时尚的年轻男士自信地站立在一扇装饰着精美雕刻的宏伟传统木门前。他身着一件精致的米白色库尔塔（kurta），上面点缀着细腻的金色刺绣，散发出低调的奢华感。他的姿态放松而沉着，一只手随意地插在口袋里，另一只手则在整理衣领，表情平静而自信。

他留着中等长度的波浪形深色头发，修剪整齐的胡须，佩戴着黑色矩形太阳镜、一款高级腕表和一枚大胆的宣言戒指。

content:
Numerous 3D Spotify and Apple Music interface cards orbiting Drake at varying depths.
Material: Translucent frosted glass (glassmorphism) with soft rounded edges and subtle glowing borders.
 Movement: Some cards are in the extreme foreground, partially obscuring Drake, while others drift into the distance behind him.
Visual Accents: Dynamic motion blur on the edges of the cards to suggest a swirling, orbiting movement.
LIGHTING & COMPOSITION
Lighting: Natural tones with enhanced professional photo quality. The soft glow from the interface cards subtly illuminates Drake’s face.
Focus: Strong depth of field. The background and extreme foreground cards are artistically blurred, keeping the focus sharp on Drake and the closest player interfaces.
Composition: A cinematic wide or medium shot that emphasizes the scale of the floating AR elements.
AESTHETIC
High-end editorial music photography, futuristic AR concept, clean and airy vibe. 8k resolution, sophisticated lighting, and realistic textures on the glass cards.

美学
高端编辑音乐摄影，未来感 AR 概念，干净通透的氛围。8k 分辨率，精致的光照，玻璃卡片上逼真的纹理。

title: 角色参考表，确保一致性
description: 这是一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的高度结构化提示，旨在根据上传的图像创建专业的角色参考表，确保在 AI 视频生成中，多个视图（正面、侧面、背面和特写）之间保持完美的身份一致性。
content: Create a professional character reference sheet based strictly on the uploaded reference image. Use a clean, neutral plain background and present the sheet as a technical model turnaround while matching the exact realistic visual style of the reference (same realism level, rendering approach, texture, color treatment, and overall aesthetic). Arrange the composition into two horizontal rows. Top row: four full-body standing views placed side-by-side in this order: front view, left profile view (facing left), right profile view (facing right), back view. Bottom row: three highly detailed close-up portraits aligned beneath the full-body row in this order: front portrait, left profile portrait (facing left), right profile portrait (facing right). Maintain perfect identity consistency across every panel. Keep the subject in a relaxed A-pose and with consistent scale and alignment between views, accurate anatomy, and clear silhouette; ensure even spacing and clean panel separation, with uniform framing and consistent head height across the full-body lineup and consistent facial scale across the portraits. Lighting should be consistent across all panels (same direction, intensity, and softness), with natural, controlled shadows that preserve detail without dramatic mood shifts. Output a crisp, print-ready reference sheet look, sharp details.
translatedContent: 根据上传的参考图像，严格制作一张专业的角色参考表。使用干净、中性的纯色背景，并将参考表呈现为技术模型转盘，同时与参考图像的精确写实视觉风格保持一致（相同的写实水平、渲染方法、纹理、色彩处理和整体美学）。将构图排列成两行水平行。顶行：四个全身站立视图并排排列，顺序为：正面视图、左侧面视图（面向左）、右侧面视图（面向右）、背面视图。底行：三个高度精细的特写肖像，排列在全身行下方，顺序为：正面肖像、左侧面肖像（面向左）、右侧面肖像（面向右）。在每个面板中保持完美的身份一致性。让主体保持放松的 A 姿势，并在视图之间保持一致的比例和对齐，准确的解剖结构和清晰的轮廓；确保均匀的间距和清晰的面板分隔，全身排列中保持统一的构图和一致的头部高度，肖像中保持一致的面部比例。所有面板的光照应保持一致（相同的方向、强度和柔和度），并带有自然、受控的阴影，在不产生剧烈情绪变化的情况下保留细节。输出清晰、可供打印的参考表外观，细节锐利。

description: 一个高度结构化、多阶段的提示，专为 Nano Banana Pro 设计，用于可视化复杂的科学或数学理论。它指示模型将理论分解为视觉语言，从 2D 符号过渡到 3D 不可能结构，并以等距、设计师玩具风格包含一个比例模型观察者（科学家）。
content:
2x2 grid, do this for 4 famous PHD level science or math topics <instructions>
 Input Variable:  {argument name="theorem or formula" default="Theorem / Formula"}
Phase 1: Schematic Decomposition
Analyze the Notation: Identify the primary visual language of the scientist (Chalk on blackboard? Ink on parchment? Pencil on graph paper?).
Identify the "Structure": If this theory were a building, what would it look like?
Logic: Chaos Theory -> Fractal Spire. Thermodynamics -> Engine Block.
Phase 2: The Dimensional Transition
The Base: A flat surface covered in the [Notation Medium] (e.g., a slate blackboard covered in chalk equations).
The Extrusion: The chalk lines physically lift off the surface. They begin as white wireframes, then gain opacity, then gain texture.
The Climax: At the top of the image, the wireframes have fully solidified into a photorealistic, impossible structure representing the theory.
The Observer: A tiny, scale-model figure of the scientist stands on the flat "2D" section, looking up in awe at the massive "3D" structure they have summoned.
Output: High-Angle Isometric, "3D mod designer toy" style, stark contrast between sketchy lines and solid mass.
</instructions>
translatedContent:
2x2 网格，为 4 个著名的博士级别科学或数学主题执行此操作 <instructions>
输入变量：{argument name="theorem or formula" default="Theorem / Formula"}
阶段 1：示意图分解
分析符号：确定科学家的主要视觉语言（黑板上的粉笔？羊皮纸上的墨水？方格纸上的铅笔？）。
识别“结构”：如果这个理论是一座建筑，它会是什么样子？
逻辑：混沌理论 -> 分形尖塔。热力学 -> 引擎缸体。
阶段 2：维度转换
基础：一个平面，上面覆盖着 [Notation Medium]（例如，一块覆盖着粉笔方程的石板黑板）。
挤压：粉笔线条从表面物理地抬起。它们最初是白色线框，然后获得不透明度，然后获得纹理。
高潮：在图像顶部，线框已完全凝固成一个逼真的、不可能的结构，代表着该理论。
观察者：一个微小的、按比例缩小的科学家模型人物站在平坦的“2D”部分，敬畏地仰望着他们召唤出的巨大“3D”结构。

title: 复古 1980-1990 年代电脑图形标志重新设计
description: 一个详细的多阶段提示，指示 Nano Banana Pro 扮演数字考古学家和复古视觉设计师的角色。目标是将一个现代标志（Grok）重新设计成 MS-DOS 或 Windows 3.1 图形风格，重点突出可见的像素化、扫描线、有限的调色板以及电子束光晕和色差等特定光效。
content: Act as a Digital Archaeologist and Retro Visual Designer specializing in 1980s-1990s Computer Graphics Aesthetics. PHASE 1: HISTORICAL CONTEXT Autonomously research the brand's modern logo and visual identity. Mentally transport this contemporary design back to the 1980s-1990s era of personal computing. Deconstruct the logo into geometric primitives that would have been technically feasible on early computer systems (squares, circles, simple gradients, limited color palettes). PHASE 2: LOGO REINTERPRETATION Redesign the [{argument name="logo name" default="GROK"}] logo as if it was created for MS-DOS, Windows 3.1, or early Macintosh systems. Rules: - Simplify complex gradients to solid fills or basic two-tone transitions - Convert modern sans-serifs to bitmap/pixelated typography - Reduce color complexity to 4-16 vibrant colors maximum - Add retro geometric elements: concentric squares, stepped borders, blocky shadows - Maintain brand recognition while applying 80s/90s design constraints PHASE 3: PIXEL STRUCTURE The logo must display visible digital pixelation characteristics: - Visible RGB subpixel grid (red, green, blue dots arranged in tight clusters) - Horizontal scanline pattern across the entire composition - Black grid separating luminous colored pixels - Chromatic aberration at high-contrast edges - Electron beam bloom around bright elements creating soft glow halos PHASE 4: VISUAL TREATMENT - Background: Pure black (#000000) with subtle digital noise/grain - Logo colors: Oversaturated, glowing, with visible RGB subpixel separation - Text rendering: Chunky bitmap font with visible pixel stepping - Surface texture: Moiré patterns, slight dust particles floating in space PHASE 5: LUMINOSITY & ATMOSPHERE - Light behavior: Emissive glow from within the pixels themselves - Bloom effect: Soft white halo around peak brightness areas - Color bleed: Slight RGB fringing where bright colors meet black background - Ambient: Complete darkness surrounding the glowing logo - Luminance falloff: Edges slightly dimmer than center (vignette effect) PHASE 6: COMPOSITION - Framing: Tight crop on logo, filling 60-70% of frame - Alignment: Perfect center, logo floating on pure black void - Focus: Sharp on pixel grid structure with shallow depth revealing slight curvature TECH SPECS: - Macro photography perspective at f/4 aperture - ISO 400 sensitivity to capture luminous glow - Color space: sRGB with boosted saturation (+30%) - Resolution: High detail showing individual pixel structure - Grain: Analog film grain overlay (ISO 800 equivalent) for vintage feel - No modern post-processing or sharpening CRITICAL DIRECTIVES: - Logo appears as PURE DIGITAL GRAPHIC floating in void—NOT displayed on any physical device - NO bezels, NO frames, NO hardware, NO screens visible - The aesthetic is "1987-1995 computer graphics" NOT "photo of old technology" - Log
translatedContent:
扮演一名数字考古学家和复古视觉设计师，专门研究 1980 年代至 1990 年代的计算机图形美学。

第一阶段：历史背景
自主研究品牌的现代标志和视觉识别。在脑海中将这种当代设计带回到 1980 年代至 1990 年代的个人计算时代。将标志解构为在早期计算机系统上技术上可行的几何图元（正方形、圆形、简单渐变、有限的调色板）。

第二阶段：标志重新诠释
重新设计 [{argument name="logo name" default="GROK"}] 标志，就像它是为 MS-DOS、Windows 3.1 或早期 Macintosh 系统创建的一样。
规则：
- 将复杂渐变简化为纯色填充或基本的双色过渡
- 将现代无衬线字体转换为位图/像素化字体
- 将颜色复杂度降低到最多 4-16 种鲜艳颜色
- 添加复古几何元素：同心正方形、阶梯边框、块状阴影
- 在应用 80 年代/90 年代设计限制的同时保持品牌识别度

第三阶段：像素结构
标志必须显示可见的数字像素化特征：
- 可见的 RGB 子像素网格（紧密排列的红色、绿色、蓝色点）
- 整个构图上的水平扫描线图案
- 分隔发光彩色像素的黑色网格
- 高对比度边缘的色差
- 明亮元素周围的电子束光晕，形成柔和的光晕

第四阶段：视觉处理
- 背景：纯黑色（#000000），带有微妙的数字噪点/颗粒
- 标志颜色：过饱和、发光，具有可见的 RGB 子像素分离
- 文本渲染：块状位图字体，具有可见的像素阶梯
- 表面纹理：莫尔条纹、漂浮在空间中的细微灰尘颗粒

第五阶段：亮度与氛围
- 光线行为：像素本身发出的自发光
- 泛光效果：峰值亮度区域周围的柔和白色光晕
- 颜色溢出：亮色与黑色背景交界处轻微的 RGB 边缘
- 环境：发光标志周围的完全黑暗
- 亮度衰减：边缘比中心稍暗（晕影效果）

第六阶段：构图
- 构图：紧密裁剪标志，占据画面的 60-70%
- 对齐：完美居中，标志漂浮在纯黑色的虚空中
- 焦点：清晰的像素网格结构，浅景深显示轻微的曲率

技术规格：
- 微距摄影视角，f/4 光圈
- ISO 400 感光度，捕捉发光效果
- 色彩空间：sRGB，饱和度提升 (+30%)
- 分辨率：高细节显示单个像素结构
- 颗粒：模拟胶片颗粒叠加（相当于 ISO 800），营造复古感
- 无现代后期处理或锐化

关键指令：
- 标志显示为漂浮在虚空中的纯数字图形——未显示在任何物理设备上
- 无边框、无框架、无硬件、无屏幕可见
- 美学是“1987-1995 年计算机图形”，而不是“旧技术的照片”
- Log

title: Nano Banana 2 的 3D Q 版角色转换提示
description: 一个详细的提示，用于 Nano Banana 2 将参考图像中的主体转换为可爱的 3D 动漫 Q 版角色。该提示强调在应用经典的 Q 版比例、将其渲染为高质量、光泽的 3D 模型，并具有鲜艳的色彩和高级收藏品美感的同时，保留主体的肖像、种族和肤色。
content: Transform the subjects into a cute anime chibi characters rendered as a clean 3D model, while preserving the subject's original race, ethnicity, skin tone, and recognizable facial likeness, including hairstyle, hair color, and clothing colors. The character must remain clearly the same person with the same skin tone and ethnic appearance as the original input, translated into a chibi form. The character should have classic chibi proportions: a very large head, small torso, simplified cute facial features, and large expressive anime-style eyes. Translate the subject's facial features into a chibi style while keeping their recognizable likeness. Frame the character from the torso up, with the camera slightly closer and cropped in, so the upper body and head fill most of the frame. The character should be looking directly into the camera, with an energetic and expressive anime-style pose. Use a slightly dynamic camera angle, such as a subtle tilt or off-axis perspective, similar to modern anime promotional artwork. The camera can be slightly lower than the character's face, creating a playful upward Tr angle that makes the character feel lively and engaging. Render the character as a high-quality glossy 3D anime-style model, similar to a polished Blender render or premium collectible figure. The materials should be smooth, reflective, and toy-like, with strong highlights, soft reflections, and shiny surfaces. The overall look should clearly resemble a 3D rendered character, not a flat 2D illustration. Use bright anime-style shading with vibrant but polished colors, giving the character a premium anime aesthetic. Place the character in front of a colorful gradient background. Behind the character, include a small number of large, translucent decorative shapes such as bubbles, stars, or rounded forms. These shapes should appear semi-transparent, glossy, and subtle, similar to clear acrylic or glass, softly floating in the background without drawing attention away from the character. The background elements should remain light, minimal, and softly visible, acting as stylish accents rather than prominent objects. The final image should look like a dynamic, glossy 3D chibi character render, with polished materials, vibrant colors, and a premium collectible aesthetic,while clearly maintaining the subject's original race, skin tone, and recognizable identity.
translatedContent: 将主体转化为可爱的动漫 Q 版角色，呈现为干净的 3D 模型，同时保留主体的原始种族、民族、肤色和可识别的面部特征，包括发型、发色和服装颜色。该角色必须清晰地保持与原始输入相同的肤色和民族外观，并以 Q 版形式呈现。该角色应具有经典的 Q 版比例：一个非常大的头部、小躯干、简化的可爱面部特征和大的富有表现力的动漫风格眼睛。将主体的面部特征转化为 Q 版风格，同时保持其可识别的相似度。从躯干以上构图，相机稍微靠近并裁剪，使上半身和头部占据大部分画面。角色应直视相机，摆出充满活力和表现力的动漫风格姿势。使用略带动态的相机角度，例如轻微倾斜或偏轴视角，类似于现代动漫宣传艺术作品。相机可以略低于角色的面部，营造出俏皮的仰视角度，使角色感觉生动活泼且引人入胜。将角色渲染为高质量、有光泽的 3D 动漫风格模型，类似于精致的 Blender 渲染或高级收藏品手办。材质应光滑、反光、具有玩具般的质感，带有强烈的高光、柔和的反射和闪亮的表面。整体外观应清晰地类似于 3D 渲染角色，而不是扁平的 2D 插图。使用明亮的动漫风格着色，色彩鲜艳但精致，赋予角色高级动漫美学。将角色放置在彩色渐变背景前。在角色身后，加入少量大型、半透明的装饰性形状，例如气泡、星星或圆形。这些形状应呈现半透明、有光泽且微妙的效果，类似于透明亚克力或玻璃，在背景中轻轻漂浮，而不会分散对角色的注意力。背景元素应保持明亮、简约且柔和可见，作为时尚的点缀而非突出的物体。最终图像应看起来像一个动态、有光泽的 3D Q 版角色渲染，具有精致的材质、鲜艳的色彩和高级收藏品美学，同时清晰地保持主体的原始种族、肤色和可识别的身份。

title: 高速赛博朋克电影场景提示
description: 一个高度详细、多部分的提示，旨在将上传的角色参考转化为雨水湿滑的赛博朋克街道上的照片级真实感、高速电影场景，强调严格的身份保留、特定的摄像机角度和动态姿势强制，推荐用于 Nano Banana 2 (Thinking Mode)。
content: A cinematic speed-motion shot of the uploaded reference character captured mid-slide on a rain-slicked, neon-drenched cyberpunk street. The focus is equally on the reflection and the character, forming a dual-layer composition. Likeness Preservation (CRITICAL): Maintain exact proportions, eye shape, spacing, stylization, silhouette, and material identity from the reference. Do not humanize. Do not reinterpret anatomy. Do not modify facial structure. Identity must remain perfectly intact and instantly recognizable. 2D to 3D Translation (ONLY if input is 2D artwork): If the uploaded reference is 2D (illustration, anime, flat graphic, cel-shaded), convert it into a fully realized 3D cinematic form while preserving exact identity fidelity. Maintain exact head shape, eye design, spacing, and proportions. Preserve original stylization, do NOT add realism that alters design language. Translate linework into subtle surface geometry or shading transitions. Keep original colors, expressed through physically believable materials. Convert flat shading into controlled cinematic light falloff. The result must feel physically real, not redesigned. Camera & Perspective: Ultra-low angle, camera positioned just centimeters above the wet pavement. Lens: 18–20mm ultra-wide. Slight Dutch tilt (5–10 degrees) to destabilize the frame. Front three-quarter perspective. One limb or body part must be closer to the lens, creating perspective pressure. Composition (Reflection Dominance): The character slices diagonally across the upper half of the frame. The lower half is dominated by a sharp but slightly distorted reflection. Vertical neon signs in the background must mirror into the wet ground, forming strong graphic lines. The composition must feel off-balance and tension-driven, not centered or stable. Pose Enforcement (CRITICAL — OVERRIDE ALL DEFAULT STANCES): The character must NOT be upright, balanced, or casually sliding. The pose must represent loss of balance under high speed. The torso is pitched aggressively forward, close to the ground. One limb forcefully contacts the wet surface, creating splash and friction. The opposite limb extends outward or backward, fully stretched for counterbalance. Legs are asymmetrical: one trailing, one collapsing or stepping incorrectly. Spine forms a diagonal or curved line, never vertical. Head leads the motion slightly ahead of the torso. Weight Distribution: Weight is NOT centered. It collapses toward the contacting limb and forward motion. Ground Interaction (MANDATORY): Water splashes outward from impact points. Friction streaks beneath sliding limb. Surface tension visibly disturbed. Energy Read: The pose must feel like mid-fall recovery, evasive maneuver at high speed, barely controlled momentum. NOT clean skating, surfing, balanced glide, or upright slide. Perspective Amplification: At least one limb must appear larger due to proximity to the lens, enhancing speed and aggression. Motion & Blur: Directional motion blur trailing from the lowest moving limbs. Sharp focal plane on the face or upper torso. Background and trailing limbs fall into controlled blur. Lighting & Color (Cyberpunk Neon): Hard directional neon lighting from off-screen vertical sources. Color palette: deep cyan, magenta, electric yellow. Lighting behavior: sharp highlights on wet surfaces, strong rim light separating silhouette, deep shadow pockets. No flat lighting. Surface Detail (Hyper-Reflective): Wet pavement must feel physically real: mirror-like reflections with ripple distortion, micro scratches and pooling water, subtle rain impact patterns. Character materials slightly darkened from moisture. Atmosphere: Heavy rain and mist in the background. Volumetric light beams cutting through haze. Dense air perspective. Foreground may include subtle water droplets or mist near lens for depth. Emotion: Urgency. Instability. High-stakes motion. The character is either escaping or chasing. Negative Constraints: No centered composition. No upright balanced pose. No clean symmetrical stance. No dry surfaces. No flat reflections. No studio lighting. No evenly sharp full-frame clarity. No static posture. Background Pixel Wall Art (Depth-Controlled): Replace the LED sign with a weathered wall-mounted pixel-art mural or printed panel of the character. The pixel version must preserve silhouette and identity but appear faded, worn, and partially damaged. Printed or painted on a rough wall surface, not glowing like a screen. Subtle grime, scratches, peeling, or moisture distortion. Colors desaturated and affected by environment. Depth Control (CRITICAL): Must sit clearly in the background plane. Slightly obscured by haze, rain, or foreground motion. Edges softened, not crisp. Reduced contrast compared to main subject. Lighting Integration: Does NOT emit light. Only receives ambient neon spill. Partially falls into shadow. Pixel Art Identity Lock (CRITICAL): The pixel-art version must be a direct downscaled translation of the original character, not a reinterpretation. Preserve exact silhouette, head shape, and proportions. Preserve exact eye shape and spacing in simplified pixel form. Use the same facial structure logic — do NOT invent or add features. STRICT PROHIBITIONS: No added nose. No added mouth. No added facial features that do not exist in the original. No stylization drift toward generic pixel characters. If the original character has a minimal or abstract face, the pixel version must remain equally minimal. Foreground Chaos Layer (CRITICAL – DEPTH & IMMERSION): Introduce aggressive near-lens elements that partially obstruct the frame and enhance depth. Near-Lens Elements: Water droplets, splashes, or streaks crossing very close to the camera. Out-of-focus rain particles catching neon light. Small debris or mist fragments passing across the lens plane. These elements must feel physically between the viewer and the character, not part of the background. Depth Behavior (MANDATORY): Foreground elements are heavily out of focus due to proximity. Large soft bokeh shapes or streaks may partially cover edges of the frame. Some elements may briefly occlude parts of the character or reflection. The frame must feel layered: foreground chaos, main subject, background environment. Lens Interaction (IMPORTANT): Subtle water streaks or droplets may appear on the lens surface. Slight distortion or refraction through droplets is allowed. Effects must remain minimal and believable, never covering the focal subject completely. Lighting Interaction: Foreground particles catch neon light (cyan, magenta, yellow). Creates glowing streaks or soft colored flares. Adds dimensional separation between planes. Composition Impact: Frame edges may feel dirty or partially blocked. The image should NOT feel clean or perfectly framed. Slight visual interference is intentional. Emotion: The viewer feels inside the scene, not watching it. ar 16:9
translatedContent: 一个电影般的快速运动镜头，捕捉到上传的参考角色在雨水湿滑、霓虹闪烁的赛博朋克街道上滑行时的瞬间。焦点均匀地分布在倒影和角色上，形成双层构图。形象保留（关键）：保持与参考图像完全相同的比例、眼睛形状、间距、风格化、轮廓和材质特性。不要人性化。不要重新诠释解剖结构。不要修改面部结构。身份必须完美无缺且一眼可辨。2D 到 3D 转换（仅当输入为 2D 艺术作品时）：如果上传的参考图像是 2D（插画、动漫、平面图形、赛璐珞着色），请将其转换为完全实现的 3D 电影形式，同时保持精确的身份保真度。保持精确的头部形状、眼睛设计、间距和比例。保留原始风格化，不要添加会改变设计语言的写实元素。将线条转换为微妙的表面几何形状或着色过渡。保持原始颜色，通过物理上可信的材料表达。将平面着色转换为受控的电影光线衰减。结果必须感觉真实，而不是重新设计。相机与视角：超低角度，相机放置在湿路面上方仅几厘米处。镜头：18–20mm 超广角。轻微的荷兰式倾斜（5–10 度）以破坏画面稳定性。四分之三正面视角。一个肢体或身体部位必须更靠近镜头，产生透视压力。构图（倒影主导）：角色对角线穿过画面的上半部分。下半部分由清晰但略微扭曲的倒影主导。背景中的垂直霓虹灯牌必须倒映在湿地面上，形成强烈的图形线条。构图必须感觉失衡和充满张力，而不是居中或稳定。姿势强制（关键 — LED 标志。像素版本必须保留轮廓和身份，但显得褪色、磨损和部分损坏。印刷或绘制在粗糙的墙壁表面上，不发光，不像屏幕。细微的污垢、划痕、剥落或潮湿变形。颜色饱和度降低并受环境影响。深度控制（关键）：必须清晰地位于背景平面中。被薄雾、雨水或前景运动略微遮挡。边缘柔和，不锐利。与主要主体相比对比度降低。灯光整合：不发光。只接收环境霓虹灯溢光。部分陷入阴影。像素艺术身份锁定（关键）：像素艺术版本必须是原始角色的直接缩小转换，而不是重新诠释。保留精确的轮廓、头部形状和比例。以简化的像素形式保留精确的眼睛形状和间距。使用相同的面部结构逻辑 深度与沉浸感）：引入侵略性的近镜头元素，部分遮挡画面并增强深度。近镜头元素：非常靠近相机的水滴、水花或水痕。捕捉到霓虹灯光的失焦雨滴。穿过镜头平面的小碎片或薄雾。这些元素必须感觉物理上位于观众和角色之间，而不是背景的一部分。深度行为（强制）：前景元素由于靠近而严重失焦。大的柔和散景形状或条纹可能会部分覆盖画面边缘。一些元素可能会短暂遮挡角色或倒影的部分。画面必须感觉分层：前景混乱、主要主体、背景环境。镜头互动（重要）：镜头表面可能会出现细微的水痕或水滴。允许通过水滴产生轻微的扭曲或折射。效果必须保持最小且可信，绝不能完全覆盖焦点主体。灯光互动：前景粒子捕捉霓虹灯光（青色、洋红色、黄色）。产生发光的条纹或柔和的彩色光晕。增加平面之间的维度分离。构图影响：画面边缘可能感觉脏乱或部分被遮挡。图像不应感觉干净或完美构图。轻微的视觉干扰是故意的。情感：观众感觉身临其境，而不是旁观。宽高比 translatedContent: 角色：一位 20 岁的日本偶像，外表甜美，略带一丝性感，拥有半透明的白皙肌肤。面部细节：小巧柔和的圆润脸型，流畅的面部线条，纤细的下巴，五官匀称。大而圆的深棕色眼睛，纵向开合度高，巩膜明亮，眼神光突出。自然的双眼皮。卧蚕清晰。眉毛纤细平直。鼻梁低矮，鼻尖圆润。小巧的心形嘴唇，粉嫩带微光，略微张开。肌肤均匀光滑，如瓷般细腻，带有自然的红晕。发型：乌黑长直发，质感柔顺，带有轻薄的空气刘海。服装：带有成人角色扮演感的西装式校服，白色衬衫解开第二颗纽扣，领带松散，灰色马甲，整体造型略显随意。姿势：特写自拍构图，头部略微倾斜，眼神直视镜头，表情略带挑逗。背景：柔和的室内环境，背景虚化。拍摄细节：智能手机前置摄像头，浅景深，柔焦，自然光，略带光晕效果。TikTok UI：9:16 竖屏格式，UI 元素位于右侧，字幕位于底部，强烈的压缩噪点，自动曝光波动（亮度变化），轻微的运动模糊，画面倾斜（3-7 度），以及不稳定的构图。

title: 黑暗、忧郁、写实肖像提示词
description: 一个给 Nano Banana Pro 的提示，用于创作一张黑暗、情绪化、写实风格的年轻男子肖像，他身穿黑色高领毛衣和外套。场景强调柔和的侧光源带来的低调照明，营造出深邃的阴影和原始的电影氛围，并带有厚重的胶片颗粒和柔和的色彩分级。
content:

He is seated on a simple wooden chair, body slightly turned sideways, head tilted downward, eyes cast toward his hands in a contemplative, melancholic expression. He wears a black high-neck turtleneck under a long black overcoat with soft matte fabric. Normal wavy hair.
Background is a rough, textured wall with subtle stains and uneven paint, desaturated green-gray tones. Lighting is extremely low-key, coming from a soft side source (left side), creating deep shadows that partially obscure facial features while still keeping them faintly visible. Composition is medium shot, slightly off center framing. Add heavy film grain, analog noise, subtle blur, and muted color grading.
Keep everything natural and realistic: no stylization, no extra elements, no modern sharpness. Extremely grainy.
Maintain consistent shadows, realistic proportions, and a raw cinematic atmosphere with imperfect texture and slight noise artifacts.

创作一幅黑暗、忧郁、超写实的年轻男子肖像（20 岁出头，脸型瘦削，皮肤苍白，下颌线柔和而清晰，凌乱的中长波浪形深色头发部分遮盖额头）。他坐在一张简单的木椅上，身体略微侧转，头向下倾斜，目光投向自己的双手，表情沉思而忧郁。他穿着黑色高领毛衣，外面套着一件柔软哑光面料的黑色长款大衣。头发自然卷曲。

content:
Scene Description: A high-resolution, cinematic, macro, vertical photograph (9:16 aspect ratio). A single, large, perfect red strawberry stands perfectly upright at the center of a rich, deep red pool of viscous strawberry syrup. This central strawberry is heavily dusted with fine, powdered pink berry residue, particularly around its intact green leafy hull, and is slick with intricate, visible condensation water droplets, giving it a cool, textured appearance.
Key Visual Effects: Delicate, intricate, wispy plumes of white steam or smoke curl and rise from the top of the strawberry, creating a dramatic, ethereal interaction with the dark, moody, textured background, suggesting a culinary or frozen process.
Environment and Details: The strawberry syrup pool is set on a dark, textured slate surface. Around the pool, a natural, textured frame is created by scattered smaller fresh wild strawberries, delicate pink wild strawberry flowers, additional powdered berry dust, and small strawberry slices. All these elements form a detailed, natural setting.
Lighting and Style: The lighting is dramatic and sidelit, precisely highlighting every single texture, water droplet, powdered particle, and smoke tendril. The entire scene has a strong sense of depth and cinematic drama, tightly focused on the central strawberry.
Aspect Ratio: Vertical 9:16 (or 9 to 16).
translatedContent:
场景描述：一张高分辨率、电影感十足的微距竖幅照片（9:16 宽高比）。一颗硕大、完美的红色草莓笔直地立在浓稠的深红色草莓糖浆中央。这颗中央的草莓表面撒满了细腻的粉红色浆果碎屑，尤其是在其完好无损的绿色叶萼周围，并且布满了错综复杂、清晰可见的冷凝水珠，使其呈现出一种清凉、富有质感的视觉效果。
关键视觉效果：纤细、精致、缥缈的白色蒸汽或烟雾从草莓顶部袅袅升起，与深沉、富有情调的纹理背景形成戏剧性、空灵的互动，暗示着烹饪或冷冻过程。
环境与细节：草莓糖浆池置于深色、有纹理的石板表面。糖浆池周围，散落着更小的野生新鲜草莓、精致的粉红色野生草莓花、额外的浆果粉末和少量草莓切片，共同构成了一个自然、富有纹理的边框。所有这些元素共同营造出一个细节丰富、自然的环境。
光线与风格：光线具有戏剧性，采用侧光照明，精准地突显了每一个纹理、水珠、粉末颗粒和烟雾卷须。整个场景具有强烈的纵深感和电影般的戏剧性，焦点紧密地集中在中央的草莓上。
宽高比：竖幅 9:16（或 9 比 16）。

title: 纳米香蕉 2 号音符插画提示（罗斯柴尔德历史场景）
description: 一个针对 Nano Banana 2 的综合系统提示，指示它扮演专业插画师和提示工程师的角色，为一篇关于梅耶·阿姆谢尔·罗斯柴尔德的博客文章创作一幅视觉吸引力强、扁平化设计的插画。该提示详细说明了风格、颜色、构图和历史背景。
content:
# 指示
あなたはプロのイラストレーター兼プロンプトエンジニアです。
以下の【ブログの要点】を読み、その内容を直感的に伝える魅力的な挿絵を作成してください。
挿絵の上部にタイトルを表示してください。

# 画像サイズ
1280px × 670px（アスペクト比16:9）

# 出力条件
ブランドカラー：[#06c7b0]
シンプルかつ清潔感のあるフラットデザイン。
均一な黒のアウトライン線で描かれた人物やアイコンを配置し、 パステル調のアクセントカラー（スカイブルー、コーラルピンクなど）を部分的に使用。
丸みを帯びた形状と柔らかい印象を重視。
図解中心の構成（例：ベン図、棒グラフ、吹き出しなど）で、学生や若年層が見る資料やSNS向けの親しみやすいトーン。
余白を多く取り、視認性とバランスを意識したデザイン。
出てくる人物は１８世紀ヨーロッパ貴族の格好をしている

#ブログの要点
マイヤー・アムシェル・ロスチャイルドは決して恵まれた階層の生まれではありませんでしたが、ある転機が訪れます。それは地域の支配者である、ヘッセン選帝侯ヴィルヘルム9世に古銭を提供するという機会を得たのです。
でも、それだけではどこにでもいる古銭承商です。
彼が普通ではなかったことは、「市場価格よりも圧倒的に安く、利益を度外視して」 希少な古銭をヴィルヘルム9世へ提供し続けたことでした。
普通なら、権力者相手ならふっかけたくなるものです。しかし彼は、目先の小銭を拾うことよりも、気に入られることを優先しました。
translatedContent:
# 说明
你是一位专业的插画师和提示工程师。
请阅读以下 [博客摘要]，并创作一幅能直观传达其内容的精美插画。
在插画顶部显示标题。

# 图片尺寸
1280px × 670px（长宽比 16:9）

# 输出要求
品牌色：[#06c7b0]
简洁明快的扁平化设计。
人物和图标采用统一的黑色轮廓绘制，局部使用柔和的强调色（天蓝色、珊瑚粉等）。
强调圆润的造型和柔和的视觉效果。
以图表为中心的构图（例如，维恩图、条形图、对话气泡），风格友好，适合学生和年轻人阅读的材料或社交媒体。
设计留有充足的空白，优先考虑可见性和平衡感。
出现的人物应穿着 18 世纪欧洲贵族的服饰。

# 博客摘要
梅耶·阿姆谢尔·罗斯柴尔德并非出身特权阶层，但他的人生迎来了一个转折点。他获得了向黑森选帝侯威廉九世（一位地区统治者）提供古董硬币的机会。然而，仅仅如此，他也不过是另一位古董硬币商人。他与众不同之处在于，他持续以“远低于市场价、不计利润”的价格向威廉九世提供稀有古董硬币。通常，人们会试图向有权势的人索取高价。但他优先考虑的是获得青睐，而非眼前的蝇头小利。

title: 电影级微距玩具摄影：冲刺中的角色
description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于使用 Nano Banana 2 生成电影级的微距玩具摄影场景，描绘一个来自上传参考图像的豆子大小的角色，在角色设计页面上爆发性地冲刺，强调精确的相似性保留和动态动作效果。
content: A cinematic macro toy-photography scene. A bean-sized version of the uploaded reference character is sprinting explosively captured at the peak stride moment of a high-speed sprint with visual effect. Character Pose: A dynamic, mid-sprint action pose with amazing visual effects captured from a three-quarter side profile. Torso: Leaning forward at a sharp angle to convey momentum. Arms: One arm is bent sharply at the elbow with the fist tucked near the chest; the other arm is extended backward, trailing behind the torso. Legs: In a full stride. The lead leg is bent forward with the knee high, while the trailing leg is fully extended back with the foot pointed. Head: Facing forward, aligned with the direction of the run. The character runs across the surface of several giant black-and-white character design pages fully covering the ground, featuring the same character. Likeness Preservation (CRITICAL): The identity of the character must remain exactly identical to the reference in both: • the miniature physical character • the character shown in the design sketches. The sketch pages must show the same character, including: • dynamic poses small sketches • head studies and shape explorations • proportion notes • accessory sketches • construction diagrams • small handwritten annotations. Maintain the exact: • head shape • eye shape and spacing • stylization • silhouette • materials and clothing design. If the character wears a balaclava, mask, helmet, or covered face, the sketches must not invent facial anatomy. No added nose. No added mouth. No visible skin where the reference does not show it. Do not humanize the character. Do not reinterpret anatomy. Subject & Action: The miniature character sprints explosively across the design pages, tearing through the sketch sheet as it runs. The character is captured at the peak stride moment of a full-speed sprint. Running pose details: • the body leans sharply forward as if accelerating • one leg is fully extended forward while the other drives powerfully backward • arms pump in opposite running motion • the torso twists slightly creating a dynamic curved spine line • the pose feels like a high-speed comic-book sprint. The character’s momentum rips through the paper, creating a jagged torn path behind it. A trail of torn paper curls and fragments with vfx follows behind the running character as if it burst out of its own design. Oversized design sheets surround the character, each page showing different stages of development of the same character. One small grey 3d print of the character is in the background as an exact copy of the uploaded image. Camera & Perspective: Captured from a medium camera distance above the desk, allowing a wider portion of the surrounding design pages to be visible. Shot with an 85mm macro lens, creating natural compression while keeping the environment readable. The camera sits slightly elevated and angled downward toward the running character. The character remains the focal point but occupies roughly one third of the frame, revealing more of the design sheets and workspace around it. The character remains slightly off-center within the spotlight. Depth of Field: Extremely shallow depth of field. The sprinting miniature character and the immediate section of the torn sketch page are razor sharp. Surrounding pages and distant elements fall into soft blur. Lighting (VERY DRAMATIC): A single narrow spotlight / flashlight beam hits the character. The beam comes from a side-front direction, creating a bright circular pool of light on the design page. Lighting characteristics: • extremely hard light • very high contrast • no ambient fill light • the surrounding elements fades into near-total darkness • sharp dramatic shadows stretch across the paper • edges of the light beam fall rapidly into black. The environment outside the spotlight should feel almost completely swallowed by darkness, as if the character has been suddenly caught under a stage light. Dust particles float through the beam. Environment & Surface Detail: Macro-level detail of the design pages: • ink texture • pencil strokes • paper fibers • subtle reflections on graphite lines. The torn paper edge reveals fibrous paper layers and curled fragments along the ripped path. Subtle Heat Burn Detail: Along parts of the torn path, the paper shows light scorching caused by extreme speed friction: • edges of some tears are slightly darkened and singed • faint burnt browning transitions into the white paper fibers • tiny ember-like glowing specks appear briefly along the freshest tear points • very subtle wisps of heat distortion or smoke rise from a few edges. The burn effect must remain minimal, believable, and physically grounded, enhancing realism without turning into flames or overpowering the scene. Color Grade: Desaturated sketch pages and environment. The character receives cool cinematic highlights from the spotlight. Moody macro photography atmosphere. Rendering Style: Photorealistic macro toy photography, emphasizing scale illusion between the tiny character and the giant design pages. Speed Energy VFX: A stylized high-speed energy trail follows behind the running character, emphasizing the explosive sprint. The trail consists of thin luminous motion streaks and glowing particles streaming backward from the character’s movement direction. Characteristics: • energy streaks originate from behind the character’s shoulders, arms, and legs • streaks extend diagonally backward, following the direction of motion • the lines are semi-transparent glowing blue light trails • small sparkling particles scatter along the trail • the effect should feel like comic-book speed energy, not smoke or fire • the VFX enhances motion but does not cover or obscure the character. The light streaks interact subtly with the environment: • faint glow reflecting on the torn paper edges • slight blue rim light on the character’s silhouette • a few glowing particles floating through the spotlight beam. The energy trail should feel fast, sharp, and directional, reinforcing the sense that the character is sprinting at extreme speed. ar 3:2
translatedContent: 一个电影般的微距玩具摄影场景。上传的参考角色被缩小成豆粒大小，以高速冲刺的最高步幅瞬间被捕捉，并带有视觉效果。角色姿态：一个充满活力的、冲刺中的动作姿态，从四分之三侧面视角捕捉到惊人的视觉效果。躯干：以锐角向前倾斜，以传达动量。手臂：一只手臂肘部急剧弯曲，拳头靠近胸部；另一只手臂向后伸展，拖在躯干后面。腿部：处于完全的步幅中。前腿向前弯曲，膝盖高抬，而后腿完全向后伸展，脚尖朝后。头部：朝前，与奔跑方向对齐。角色奔跑在几张巨大的黑白角色设计图纸表面，这些图纸完全覆盖地面，并描绘了同一个角色。形象保留（关键）：角色的身份必须与参考图完全一致，包括： • 微型实体角色 • 设计草图中显示的角色。草图页面必须显示相同的角色，包括： • 动态姿态的小草图 • 头部研究和形状探索 • 比例注释 • 配件草图 • 结构图 • 小手写注释。保持精确的： • 头部形状 • 眼睛形状和间距 • 风格化 • 轮廓 • 材料和服装设计。如果角色戴着巴拉克拉瓦头套、面具、头盔或面部被遮盖，草图不得虚构面部解剖结构。不得添加鼻子。不得添加嘴巴。参考图中未显示皮肤的地方不得显示皮肤。不要将角色拟人化。不要重新诠释解剖结构。主题与动作：微型角色在设计图纸上爆发性冲刺，奔跑时撕裂草图纸。角色被捕捉在全速冲刺的最高步幅瞬间。奔跑姿态细节： • 身体急剧前倾，仿佛正在加速 • 一条腿完全向前伸展，而另一条腿则有力地向后蹬 • 双臂以相反的跑步动作摆动 • 躯干略微扭曲，形成动态的弧形脊柱线 • 姿态感觉像高速漫画书中的冲刺。角色的动量撕裂纸张，在其身后形成一条锯齿状的撕裂路径。一道带有视觉特效的撕裂纸屑卷曲和碎片轨迹跟随着奔跑的角色，仿佛它从自己的设计中迸发出来。超大的设计图纸环绕着角色，每页都显示了同一角色的不同发展阶段。背景中有一个小的灰色 3D 打印角色，与上传的图像完全一致。相机与透视：从桌面上方中等相机距离捕捉，使得周围设计图纸的更大部分可见。使用 85mm 微距镜头拍摄，产生自然的压缩，同时保持环境可读。相机略微抬高并向下倾斜对准奔跑的角色。角色仍然是焦点，但占据画面约三分之一，展现了更多周围的设计图纸和工作区。角色略微偏离聚光灯中心。景深：景深极浅。冲刺中的微型角色和撕裂草图页的即时部分非常清晰。周围的页面和远处的元素则柔和模糊。灯光（非常戏剧化）：一道狭窄的聚光灯/手电筒光束照射在角色上。光束从侧前方射来，在设计图纸上形成一个明亮的圆形光池。灯光特点： • 极其硬朗的光线 • 非常高的对比度 • 无环境补光 • 周围元素逐渐融入近乎完全的黑暗 • 锐利的戏剧性阴影投射在纸张上 • 光束边缘迅速变黑。聚光灯外的环境应该感觉几乎完全被黑暗吞噬，仿佛角色突然被舞台灯光捕捉到。灰尘颗粒在光束中漂浮。环境与表面细节：设计图纸的微距细节： • 墨水纹理 • 铅笔笔触 • 纸张纤维 • 石墨线条上的细微反光。撕裂的纸张边缘展现出纤维状的纸层和沿撕裂路径卷曲的碎片。细微的热烧伤细节：沿撕裂路径的部分区域，纸张显示出由极高速摩擦引起的轻微烧焦： • 某些撕裂边缘略微变暗和烧焦 • 微弱的烧焦褐色过渡到白色纸张纤维中 • 微小的余烬状发光斑点在最新撕裂点处短暂出现 • 极细微的热扭曲或烟雾从几个边缘升起。烧伤效果必须保持最小、可信且符合物理原理，增强真实感，而不是变成火焰或压倒场景。色彩分级：设计草图页面和环境去饱和。角色从聚光灯中获得冷色调的电影高光。情绪化的微距摄影氛围。渲染风格：写实微距玩具摄影，强调微小角色与巨大设计图纸之间的尺度错觉。速度能量视觉特效：一道风格化的高速能量轨迹跟随着奔跑的角色，强调爆发性冲刺。轨迹由细长的发光运动条纹和从角色运动方向向后流动的发光粒子组成。特点： • 能量条纹源自角色肩部、手臂和腿部后方 • 条纹对角线向后延伸，遵循运动方向 • 线条是半透明的发光蓝色光迹 • 小小的闪烁粒子散布在轨迹上 • 效果应感觉像漫画书中的速度能量，而不是烟雾或火焰 • 视觉特效增强运动，但不覆盖或遮挡角色。光迹与环境微妙互动： • 撕裂纸张边缘的微弱反光 • 角色轮廓上的轻微蓝色边缘光 • 几个发光粒子在聚光灯光束中漂浮。能量轨迹应感觉快速、锐利且有方向性，强化角色以极高速冲刺的感觉。ar 3:2

description: 为 Nano Banana 2 提供一个详细的提示，用于创建一张演歌（日本传统民谣）风格的 CD 封面，并使用一张人物参考图片。该提示详细说明了设计元素、戏剧性氛围、标题要求（演歌风格、毛笔字体）以及要排除的元素（条形码、徽标等）。
content:
リファレンス画像に写っている人物を同一人物として使用し、その人物がリリースした「演歌のCDジャケット」をデザインしてください。

重要:
・人物の顔や特徴はリファレンス画像から忠実に再現する
・元画像の構図、カメラアングル、ポーズ、背景には縛られない
・新しくCDジャケット用に構図を大胆に再構成する
・実在する演歌CDジャケットのような完成度の高いデザインにする

デザイン要素:
・演歌らしいドラマチックで情緒的な雰囲気
・昭和～現代演歌のCDジャケットのようなデザイン
・人物は中央または印象的な配置
・強い感情表現（哀愁、決意、切なさなど）
・背景は自由に変更してよい。演歌の世界観を表現する情緒的でドラマチックな背景にすること。

タイトル:
・リファレンス画像の人物の雰囲気やキャラクターから推測して
「それらしい演歌のタイトル」を新しく作る
・タイトルは大きくジャケットに表示する
・演歌風の日本語タイトル
・筆文字風フォント

追加要素:
・本物のCDジャケットのようなレイアウト
・高品質、印刷用レベルのクオリティ

スタイル:
日本の演歌CDジャケット
ドラマチックなライティング
映画ポスターのような構図
高解像度
プロのグラフィックデザイン

以下の要素は一切表示しない：
・バーコード
・価格表示
・JANコード
・レコード会社ロゴ
・CDレーベルロゴ
・コピーライト表記
・発売日
・型番
・商品番号
・キャンペーンシール
・ステッカー
・宣伝バッジ
・帯（オビ）
・販売用ラベル
・ストリーミングサービスのロゴ
・Spotify / Apple Music などのアイコン
・QRコード

文字情報は「演歌タイトル」と「歌手名」のみ表示すること。「サブタイトル」は表示してもよい。
それ以外の文字・記号・数字は一切表示しない。
商業CDパッケージに見られる販売情報はすべて禁止。
translatedContent:
请设计一张由参考图片中的人物发行的“演歌 CD 封面”，将他们视为同一个人。

重要提示：
・忠实再现参考图片中人物的面部和特征
・不受原始图片的构图、摄像角度、姿势或背景的限制
・大胆地重新配置构图，以适应新的 CD 封面
・创作出高度精美的设计，如同真实的演歌 CD 封面

设计元素：
・演歌特有的戏剧性和情感氛围
・设计风格类似于昭和时代至现代的演歌 CD 封面
・人物应居中或以令人印象深刻的方式放置
・强烈的情感表达（忧郁、决心、悲伤等）
・背景可以自由更改。它应该是一个富有情感和戏剧性的背景，能够表达演歌的世界观。

标题：
・根据参考图片中人物的氛围和特征，创作一个新的“可信的演歌标题”
・标题应在封面上突出显示
・演歌风格的日语标题
・毛笔字体

附加元素：
・布局如同真实的 CD 封面
・高质量、印刷级别的品质

风格：
日式演歌 CD 封面
戏剧性灯光
电影海报般的构图
高分辨率
专业平面设计

请勿显示以下任何元素：
・条形码
・价格显示
・JAN 代码
・唱片公司标志
・CD 厂牌标志
・版权声明
・发行日期
・型号
・产品编号
・宣传贴纸
・贴纸
・促销徽章
・腰封（脊卡）
・销售标签
・流媒体服务标志
・Spotify / Apple Music 等图标
・二维码

文本信息应仅包含“演歌标题”和“歌手姓名”。也可以显示“副标题”。
不应显示其他任何字符、符号或数字。
禁止显示商业 CD 包装上常见的任何销售信息。

Her eyes are light green with hints of hazel, almond-shaped, with long defined lashes and mascara. Her eyebrows are light brown, medium thickness, softly arched, and well-groomed. She has a straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, proportional in size. Her lips are full (especially the lower lip), natural pink in color, with a slightly glossy hydrated look. She is smiling naturally with visible straight white teeth, giving a friendly, confident, relaxed expression, with slightly squinting eyes due to the smile.

Her hair is shoulder-length, dark blonde with lighter blonde highlights (balayage), styled in soft waves with a center part, naturally framing her face.

She has a slim to average build, visible from head to mid-torso, with a relaxed posture slightly angled toward the camera.

She is wearing a fitted white short-sleeve t-shirt made of soft cotton, slightly stretchy, tightly fitted. The shirt has bold red block serif text in all caps on the chest reading: “YES THEY ARE REAL”. She also wears a thin gold chain necklace with a small subtle pendant.

The lighting is natural daylight coming from the front-left, soft and diffused, creating even illumination on her face with gentle shadows and natural highlights.

The background is an indoor home setting, likely a kitchen/living area. Visible elements include a light-colored kitchen counter, white modern bar stools, a dark refrigerator (black or stainless steel) with small items or magnets attached, muted green/gray walls, light brown wooden door trim, and medium warm brown wooden flooring. The background has moderate depth and is slightly blurred.

The overall color palette includes white, red, natural skin tones, green-gray walls, wood browns, and dark appliance tones. The image style is highly realistic with minimal editing, high clarity, low noise, and natural contrast.

她的眼睛是淡绿色，带有榛色调，杏仁状，睫毛纤长分明，并涂有睫毛膏。她的眉毛是浅棕色，粗细适中，眉峰柔和，修剪整齐。她的鼻子笔直，鼻尖略圆，大小匀称。她的嘴唇丰满（尤其是下唇），呈自然的粉红色，看起来水润有光泽。她自然地微笑着，露出洁白整齐的牙齿，表情友好、自信、放松，由于微笑，眼睛略微眯起。

她的头发齐肩，深金色，带有较浅的金色挑染（巴拉亚日染发），造型为柔和的波浪，中分，自然地修饰着她的脸庞。

她身材苗条到中等，从头部到躯干中部可见，姿势放松，略微倾斜向镜头。

她穿着一件合身的白色短袖 T 恤，由柔软的棉质制成，略有弹性，非常贴身。T 恤胸前有醒目的红色大写衬线字体，写着：“YES THEY ARE REAL”。她还戴着一条细金链项链，上面有一个小巧精致的吊坠。

光线是来自左前方自然的日光，柔和而漫射，在她的脸上形成均匀的照明，带有柔和的阴影和自然的亮点。

背景是室内家居环境，可能是厨房/起居区。可见的元素包括浅色厨房台面、白色现代吧台凳、带有小物件或磁铁的深色冰箱（黑色或不锈钢）、柔和的绿色/灰色墙壁、浅棕色木门框和中等暖棕色木地板。背景具有适度的景深，并略微模糊。

整体配色包括白色、红色、自然肤色、绿色/灰色墙壁、木棕色和深色电器色调。图像风格高度逼真，后期编辑极少，清晰度高，噪点低，对比度自然。

She is wearing a fitted charcoal-grey athletic unitard (one-piece romper) made of smooth, form-fitting fabric.

title: Y2K 风格数码相机拍摄的年轻女性肖像
description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于生成一张 Y2K 偷拍数码相机摄影风格的年轻女性唯美肖像，要求面部与参考图 100% 一致，并指定姿势、妆容、服装、配饰、背景以及胶片颗粒和闪光灯等相机缺陷。
content:
Create an aesthetic portrait of a young woman in the style of Y2K candid digital camera photography, a cozy, aesthetic room setting similar to Tumblr or Pinterest photos, taken with an old digital camera with a flash to create the signature effect of 2000s digital camera photos.
The face must be 100% identical to the original reference face. Do not alter the facial shape, eyes, nose, lips, or facial features.
Pose:
She sits on the bed, holding a small silver-black camera forward slightly close to her face, as if preparing to take a photo. Her gaze is soft and slightly playful, her head slightly tilted and her shoulders relaxed. She smiles softly at the camera.

Makeup:
Soft, natural glam makeup with glowing, glass-like skin: flawless foundation, soft pink blush on the cheeks, subtle highlighter on the nose and cheekbones, thin, elongated black eyeliner, long, curly eyelashes, soft shimmering brown eyeshadow, neat, natural eyebrows, and a glossy, rosy pink lip that looks juicy and healthy.

Hair:
Black hair parted in a messy, fluffy style.

 Outfit:
A black tank top with thin straps, paired with an oversized cream hoodie that zips up to her chest and opens at one shoulder to reveal her black tank top.
A pair of thick, casual cream pants (not jogger pants) with no elastic at the bottom.

Accessories:
Transparent, cat-eye style glasses with black handles.
A small gold necklace with a minimalist pendant.

Background:
Aesthetic bedroom with a white bed sheet, no backrest, and white pillows and bolsters near the wall.
The white walls are covered with movie posters and vintage aesthetic posters from the 80s.

Lighting:
Direct camera flash, like a digital camera photo, provides bright highlights on the face and soft shadows behind.

Camera Imperfections:
Moderate film grain, slight digital noise, slight chromatic aberration, fine vignette, reddish light leak in the corners of the frame, and slightly soft focus, typical of older digital cameras.
translatedContent:
创作一张年轻女性的唯美肖像，风格为 Y2K 偷拍数码相机摄影，置身于温馨、唯美的房间，类似 Tumblr 或 Pinterest 上的照片，使用老式数码相机拍摄，并使用闪光灯营造出 2000 年代数码相机照片的标志性效果。
面部必须与原始参考面部 100% 一致。请勿改变面部形状、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇或面部特征。
姿势：
她坐在床上，手持一个银黑色的小相机，稍微靠近脸部，仿佛正准备拍照。她的目光柔和而略带俏皮，头部微微倾斜，肩膀放松。她对着镜头轻轻微笑。

妆容：
柔和、自然的魅力妆容，肌肤光泽如玻璃般：无瑕的粉底，脸颊上涂抹柔和的粉色腮红，鼻梁和颧骨处有微妙的高光，细长黑色眼线，卷翘的睫毛，柔和闪烁的棕色眼影，整洁自然的眉毛，以及水润健康的玫瑰粉色唇彩。

发型：
黑色头发，凌乱蓬松的分发。

服装：
一件黑色细肩带背心，搭配一件超大款米色连帽衫，拉链拉至胸部，一侧肩膀敞开，露出黑色背心。
一条厚实、休闲的米色长裤（非慢跑裤），裤脚无松紧带。

配饰：
透明猫眼式眼镜，黑色镜腿。
一条带有简约吊坠的小金项链。

背景：
唯美的卧室，白色床单，无床头板，靠墙放置白色枕头和长枕。
白墙上贴满了电影海报和 80 年代复古唯美海报。

灯光：
直射相机闪光灯，如同数码相机照片，在面部提供明亮的高光，并在其后方产生柔和的阴影。

相机瑕疵：
适度的胶片颗粒感、轻微的数码噪点、轻微的色差、精细的暗角、画面角落的微红色漏光，以及略微柔和的焦点，这些都是老式数码相机的典型特征。

content: アニメスタイルの可愛い女の子。茶色のボブヘアーで丸いシルエット、大きくて優しい茶色の瞳。スタイリッシュな青いブレザーの制服に茶色の蝶ネクタイ、白いソックスとローファーを着用。はにかんだような優しい笑顔でカメラ目線、にこやかに微笑んでいる。正面から見た構図で、机越しにお腹から上が描かれている。背景は、温かい光が差し込むカフェの一角のような、落ち着いた雰囲気。少女漫画風のキラキラした描写と柔らかな色彩で、可愛らしさと癒やしを表現。配信画面として、半透明のチャット欄や視聴者数表示のUIが控えめに配置されている。アスペクト比16:9。
translatedContent: 一位可爱的动漫风格女孩。棕色波波头，轮廓圆润，大大的、温柔的棕色眼睛。身穿时尚的蓝色西装制服，系着棕色领结，搭配白色短袜和乐福鞋。她温柔地微笑着，带着腼腆而愉悦的表情看着镜头。构图为正面视角，展示她从腰部以上坐在桌子后面的样子。背景氛围平静，仿佛咖啡馆一角，有温暖的光线洒入。以闪闪发光的少女漫画风格描绘和柔和的色彩，表达出可爱和治愈感。作为直播画面，半透明的聊天窗口和观众人数 UI 被巧妙地放置。画面比例 16:9。

title: 鲜艳扁平插画风格的花卉与形状图案
description: 一个用于生成生动、扁平插画的提示，插画中包含重复、密集排列的程式化花朵和几何形状图案，采用大胆的原色，让人联想到中世纪现代设计或民间艺术。
content: A vibrant, flat illustration features a repeating pattern of stylized flowers and geometric shapes on a cream background. The composition is densely packed with various floral motifs in bold, primary colors like orange, blue, pink, yellow, and purple, interspersed with black and green elements. The flowers vary in design, from simple, rounded petals to more intricate, abstract forms. Some have distinct centers, while others are solid colors. Geometric shapes, such as diamonds, triangles, and semi-circles, are strategically placed throughout the pattern, adding a graphic quality. The overall style is reminiscent of mid-century modern design or folk art, with a playful and cheerful aesthetic. The colors are flat and unshaded, and the lines are clean and defined.
translatedContent: 一幅生动活泼的扁平插画，以米色背景为底，重复着风格化的花朵和几何形状图案。构图密集，各种花卉图案以大胆的原色呈现，如橙色、蓝色、粉色、黄色和紫色，其间点缀着黑色和绿色元素。花朵设计各异，从简单的圆形花瓣到更复杂的抽象形式。有些花朵有明显的中心，而另一些则是纯色。菱形、三角形和半圆形等几何形状巧妙地分布在整个图案中，增添了图形感。整体风格让人联想到中世纪现代设计或民间艺术，呈现出一种俏皮而欢快的审美。色彩扁平且无阴影，线条干净分明。

translatedContent: 在浅灰色背景上，展示着黑白手绘的各种眼睛图案。这些眼睛大小不一，风格各异，有的睁得大大的，有的半闭着，还有的带有睫毛。线条粗犷而富有表现力，营造出一种俏皮而略带超现实主义的审美。构图密集，眼睛相互重叠，填满了整个画面，给人一种连续重复图案的印象。

title: 扭曲透视下的创意时尚摄影
description: 一个为 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro 设计的详细提示，用于生成创意时尚摄影作品，画面中一位男士呈现扭曲的透视效果（广角/鱼眼效果），强调国际象棋主题、影棚布光和光鲜的杂志风格。
content:
Creative fashion photography with distorted perspective (wide-angle lens/fisheye effect). 

The frame features a young, handsome European-looking man with dark hair. 

He is seated at a table, resting his left hand on his head (a relaxed, pensive pose), and looking directly into the lens with a confident, slightly arrogant expression. Key element (foreground): His right arm is extended strongly forward toward the camera, palm facing down.

In extreme close-up. He holds a large, glossy black chess piece (the Queen), making a move. Due to the perspective, the hand and piece appear enormous compared to the head. Setting: The table is a stylized chessboard: alternating glossy black squares and squares of textured gold leaf, with strong reflections on the surface. In the background, a black chess piece lies overturned on the table. Clothing: A loose white shirt with an open collar, a gold chain around the neck.

Background: Dark, almost black, with large white abstract geometric shapes (reminiscent of the silhouettes of a chess rook's battlements) at the edges of the frame. Lighting and Style: Studio lighting, contrasting light, high detail in the leather texture and gold, glossy magazine style, unusual angle.
translatedContent:
创意时尚摄影，采用扭曲透视（广角镜头/鱼眼效果）。

画面中是一位年轻英俊、深色头发的欧洲男性。

他坐在桌旁，左手扶着头（姿态放松，若有所思），自信而略带傲慢地直视镜头。关键元素（前景）：他的右臂有力地向前伸向镜头，手掌朝下。

特写镜头。他手持一枚巨大、光亮的黑色国际象棋棋子（皇后），正在走棋。由于透视效果，手和棋子与头部相比显得异常巨大。场景：桌子是一个风格化的棋盘：交替的光亮黑色方格和纹理金箔方格，表面有强烈的反光。背景中，一枚黑色国际象棋棋子倒在桌上。服装：一件宽松的白色衬衫，领口敞开，脖子上戴着一条金链。

背景：深色，几乎是黑色，画面边缘有大型白色抽象几何形状（让人联想到国际象棋城堡的城垛轮廓）。灯光与风格：影棚灯光，对比鲜明的光线，皮革纹理和金色细节丰富，光鲜杂志风格，不寻常的拍摄角度。

title: 英俊青年的电影肖像

content: Cinematic portrait of a handsome young man with sharp blue eyes, tousled dark brown hair swept back with a loose strand falling forward, and a neatly trimmed beard. translatedContent: 一位英俊年轻男子的电影肖像，他拥有锐利的蓝色眼睛，蓬松的深棕色头发向后梳，一缕发丝随意地垂落前方，留着修剪整齐的胡须。情绪化的低调照明，戏剧性的对比，冷蓝色调中带有微妙的红色轮廓光。四分之三侧面视角，目光强烈地凝视着镜头。身穿深色极简主义外套或夹克。浅景深，柔和的背景虚化，超逼真的皮肤纹理。黑色电影氛围，现代时尚编辑风格，85mm 镜头，f/1.8，高细节，照片级真实感，8k 画质。

title: 超逼真时尚人像，采用大胆透视手法
description: 针对 Nano Banana Pro 的高度具体提示，重点在于使用参考图像来确定身份，创作一张超现实、低角度的时尚肖像，画面中人物身穿皮质飞行员夹克，并通过伸向镜头的手营造出戏剧性的透视效果。
content:
Ultra-realistic, extremely low-angle shot (from grass level), directed vertically upward toward the model, using the uploaded reference link as the basis for identity. Preserve the exact facial structure, proportions, expression, and natural skin texture. Strict identity lock. No accessories. No alteration of facial features.
The model leans toward the camera, extending one hand forward toward the lens, creating a dramatic perspective with a strong depth effect. Direct, confident gaze.
The model is wearing a premium brown leather Armani bomber jacket with a matte smooth texture and natural creases. Underneath is a minimalist black fitted T-shirt. Dark blue wide-leg jeans made from heavy denim with natural fabric texture. White leather sneakers with clean stitching and minimal branding.
The model is positioned inside a dense circular dome of tall stems of {argument name="flowers" default="[WRITE YOUR FLOWERS]"}, forming a natural circular frame from the edges of the frame toward the center. The petals are natural, opaque, with realistic texture and slight natural imperfections.
Shot on a full-frame camera with an ultra-wide 14mm lens, aperture f/8 for deep depth of field (the face remains sharp), ISO 100 to eliminate noise, and a high shutter speed for crystal-clear detail.
Hard directional daylight as the only light source. High contrast with deep, dense shadows on the facial structure and folds of clothing. No fill light.
8K resolution, hyper-realism, clean image with no grain, sharp skin texture and detailed fashion elements. Experimental aggressive perspective as a stylistic technique. High-energy fashion aesthetic. Bold, confident visual language suitable for a luxury fashion campaign.
translatedContent:
超写实、极低角度拍摄（从草地水平），垂直向上对准模特，以提供的参考链接作为身份基础。保留精确的面部结构、比例、表情和自然的皮肤纹理。严格锁定身份。无配饰。面部特征无改动。
模特倾向镜头，一只手向前伸向镜头，营造出具有强烈景深效果的戏剧性透视感。眼神直接、自信。
模特身穿一件优质棕色皮革 Armani 飞行员夹克，夹克具有哑光光滑质感和自然褶皱。内搭一件简约黑色修身 T 恤。深蓝色阔腿牛仔裤，采用厚重丹宁布料，具有天然织物纹理。白色皮革运动鞋，缝线整洁，品牌标识极简。
模特置身于一个由高大 {argument name="flowers" default="[WRITE YOUR FLOWERS]"} 茎秆组成的密集圆形穹顶内，这些茎秆从画面边缘向中心形成一个自然的圆形框架。花瓣自然、不透明，具有逼真的纹理和轻微的自然瑕疵。

content:
5-stage horizontal manufacturing timeline, frozen mid-assembly. deep matte black background. dramatic industrial spotlights, deep shadow falloff.  
S1: Components scattered, floating, zero assembly. 
S2: Converging with speed lines, skeleton emerging. 
S3: Half-built, peak tension, fasteners mid-tighten. 
S4: Chassis open, full internals exposed. 
S5: Finished product + ghost wireframe overlay.  
Same 3/4 camera angle across all stages. Dotted trajectory arcs connect each component across stages. Each component color-coded consistently.  Title: "PRODUCT NAME - ASSEMBLY SEQUENCE" Footer: "N parts parts · X hrs · KEY SPEC"  Helvetica Neue Light labels. 4K, tack sharp. Dieter Rams precision.
translatedContent:
五阶段水平制造时间线，组装中途冻结。深哑光黑色背景。戏剧性的工业聚光灯，深邃的阴影衰减。
S1：组件分散，漂浮，零组装。
S2：随速度线汇聚，骨架浮现。
S3：半成品，张力达到峰值，紧固件正在拧紧。
S4：底盘打开，内部结构完全暴露。
S5：成品 + 幽灵线框叠加。
所有阶段均采用相同的 3/4 摄像机角度。虚线轨迹弧线连接各阶段的每个组件。每个组件的颜色编码保持一致。标题：“PRODUCT NAME - ASSEMBLY SEQUENCE” 脚注：“N parts parts · X hrs · KEY SPEC” Helvetica Neue Light 标签。4K，极致锐利。迪特·拉姆斯 (Dieter Rams) 式的精准。

title: 2x2 网格时尚摄影拼贴
description: 一个提示，用于生成一张超现实的 GQ/Vogue 风格 2x2 网格拼贴画，其中包含同一人物的四种时尚姿势（使用上传照片锁定身份），身穿深祖母绿西装外套和黑色太阳镜，并详细说明了专业的影棚灯光和相机设置。
content:
Use my uploaded photo as the identity reference.
Create a professional studio fashion photoshoot in a 2×2 grid collage showing four poses of the same person wearing black sunglasses.

Outfit: deep emerald green tailored blazer, cream/off-white dress shirt, black slim trousers, burgundy tie, optional silver watch. Blazer appears differently across frames (worn, draped over shoulder, partially removed, held).
Background: clean teal-to-turquoise gradient studio backdrop, minimal fashion studio setting.
Poses:
1.Close portrait adjusting tie.
2.Seated editorial pose leaning forward with elbow on knee.
3.Relaxed pose with vintage camera around neck.
4.Stylish pose running hand through hair while holding blazer.
Lighting: professional three-point studio lighting — softbox key light 45° camera left, soft fill light camera right, subtle rim light behind subject.
Camera: Sony A7R V, 85mm portrait lens, f/2.2, ISO 100, 1/160s, WB 5600K, shallow depth of field, focus on eyes.
Realism: natural skin pores, hair strands, subtle fabric wrinkles, realistic shadows, lens compression, reflections in sunglasses.
Output: ultra-realistic GQ/Vogue-style editorial photography, sharp detail, 4K resolution, clean 2×2 grid layout.
translatedContent:
使用我上传的照片作为身份参考。
制作一张专业的影棚时尚摄影作品，采用 2×2 网格拼贴布局，展示同一个人戴着黑色太阳镜的四种姿势。

服装：深祖母绿定制西装外套、米色/米白色正装衬衫、黑色修身长裤、勃艮第色领带，可选银色手表。西装外套在不同画面中呈现不同状态（穿着、搭在肩上、部分脱下、手持）。
背景：干净的青色到绿松石色渐变影棚背景，极简时尚影棚场景。
姿势：
1. 调整领带的特写肖像。
2. 坐姿时尚大片，身体前倾，手肘放在膝盖上。
3. 佩戴复古相机在脖子上的放松姿势。
4. 一只手穿过头发，同时手持西装外套的时尚姿势。
灯光：专业三点影棚布光——柔光箱主光位于相机左侧 45°，柔和补光位于相机右侧，主体后方有微妙的轮廓光。
相机：Sony A7R V，85mm 人像镜头，f/2.2，ISO 100，1/160s，白平衡 5600K，浅景深，对焦眼睛。
真实感：自然的皮肤毛孔、发丝、细微的织物褶皱、真实的阴影、镜头压缩、太阳镜中的反光。
输出：超逼真的 GQ/Vogue 风格时尚大片，细节锐利，4K 分辨率，干净的 2×2 网格布局。

description: 一个详细的提示，用于拍摄一款奢华腕表（WASI – W Eclipse Edition）的微距照片，腕表置于反光的黑色大理石表面上，重点突出双色表壳、镂空“W”结构展现的齿轮等精致细节，并采用富有戏剧性的电影级灯光，营造出高端广告的视觉效果。
content:
A macro photograph of an expensive, luxury wristwatch, the '{argument name="watch model" default="WASI – W Eclipse Edition"}'. The watch has a prominent two-tone case made of brushed titanium and polished rose gold with angular, complex lines. The crown, also in rose gold, has a micro-engraved 'W' emblem. The watch is placed in a three-quarter view, angled towards the right, on a highly reflective black marble surface with prominent white veining, which shows a partial reflection of the watch and its band.
​The dial is deep obsidian black, radiating a subtle sunburst pattern from the center. Its defining feature is a large, sculptural, open-worked 'W' structure made of polished metallic components that arches across the center, revealing the intricate mechanical gears of the movement beneath it. The floating 'W' serves as a dominant central element. The hours are marked by applied rose gold hour markers, with Roman numerals '12', '3', and '6'. Minute markers are visible along the outer edge. The brand name 'WASI' is minimalistically engraved at the 12 o'clock position in brushed platinum lettering.
​The hands are skeletonized and geometric, made of polished rose gold with integrated ice-blue luminous material that glows softly. There are two main hands and a central seconds hand. The strap is black matte crocodile leather with a polished rose gold deployant clasp that also has a micro-engraved 'W' insignia.
​In the background, slightly out of focus, are luxury elements including a black velvet-lined box and a wooden panel with the text 'WASI' clearly engraved, suggesting a display. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic, with soft highlights and deep shadows that emphasize the varied textures, making it look like a high-end Swiss watch advertisement.

一款昂贵的奢华腕表的微距照片，型号为“{argument name="watch model" default="WASI – W Eclipse Edition"}”。这款腕表拥有引人注目的双色表壳，由拉丝钛金属和抛光玫瑰金制成，线条棱角分明，复杂精巧。表冠同样采用玫瑰金材质，并微雕有“W”标志。腕表以四分之三的视角放置，向右倾斜，置于高度反光的黑色大理石表面上，大理石带有明显的白色纹理，映照出腕表及其表带的部分倒影。

表盘呈深邃的黑曜石色，从中心散发出微妙的放射状太阳纹。其标志性特征是一个大型、雕塑般的镂空“W”结构，由抛光金属部件制成，横跨表盘中央，展现出下方机芯精密的机械齿轮。这个悬浮的“W”作为主导性的中心元素。小时刻度由镶贴的玫瑰金时标表示，其中“12”、“3”和“6”为罗马数字。分钟刻度沿外缘可见。品牌名称“WASI”以拉丝铂金字体在 12 点钟位置简约地镌刻。

指针是镂空且几何形状的，由抛光玫瑰金制成，并集成有柔和发光的冰蓝色夜光材料。腕表有两根主指针和一根中央秒针。表带为黑色哑光鳄鱼皮材质，配有抛光玫瑰金折叠扣，折叠扣上也微雕有“W”徽章。

背景中，略微失焦的是一些奢华元素，包括一个黑色天鹅绒内衬的盒子和一个清晰刻有“WASI”字样的木质面板，暗示着一个展示场景。灯光富有戏剧性和电影感，柔和的高光和深邃的阴影强调了各种纹理，使其看起来像一则高端瑞士腕表广告。

title: 微距玩具摄影：逃离漫画格的野兽
description: 一个高度具体的微距玩具摄影提示，用于 Nano Banana 2 (Gemini – 思维模式)，以生成一个微缩角色（基于参考图像）冲刺穿过一本巨大的翻开的漫画书的场景，强调比例、浅景深和严格的相似度保留。
content:
A cinematic macro toy-photography scene.
A bean-sized version of the uploaded reference character is sprinting dramatically across the surface of a giant open comic book featuring panels of the same character.

Likeness Preservation (CRITICAL)
The identity of the character must remain exactly the same as the reference in both:
• the miniature physical character

• the comic panels printed on the page
Maintain the exact:
• head shape

• eye shape and spacing

• stylization

• silhouette

• materials and clothing design
If the character wears a balaclava, mask, helmet, or covered face, the comic panels must not invent facial anatomy.
No added nose.

No added mouth.

No visible skin where the reference does not show it.
The comic panels must depict the same exact design language of the character, only rendered as printed comic artwork.
Do not humanize the character.

Do not reinterpret anatomy.
Subject & Action
The miniature character runs across the page as if traversing its own story.
Oversized comic panels surround the character, each showing dynamic action poses of the same character, rendered in bold comic-book style.

Camera & Perspective
Low-angle macro close-up shot, camera positioned almost at page level.
Shot with a 90–100mm macro lens, giving the tiny character a heroic sense of scale.
The character sits slightly off-center, leaning forward in motion.

Depth of Field
Extremely shallow depth of field.
The running miniature character and the immediate section of the comic page are razor sharp.
The surrounding panels and distant page edges fall into soft blur.

Lighting
Sharp cinematic directional light from the top left, casting dramatic shadows across the comic page and creating small glints on the glossy print surface.

Environment & Surface Detail
Macro-level detail of the printed comic page:
ink texture

paper fibers

subtle gloss reflections
Color Grade
Rich saturated comic-book colors with warm cinematic highlights and soft ambient glow.
Moody macro photography atmosphere.

Rendering Style
Photorealistic macro toy photography aesthetic, emphasizing scale illusion between the tiny character and the giant comic book world.
ar 5:4
translatedContent:
一个电影般的微距玩具摄影场景。
上传的参考角色有一个豆子大小的版本，它正戏剧性地奔跑在一本巨大的翻开的漫画书表面，漫画书的画格里也描绘着同一个角色。

形象保留（至关重要）
角色的身份必须与参考图像中的完全一致，包括：
• 迷你实体角色

• 印刷在页面上的漫画画格

保持以下各项的精确性：
• 头部形状

• 眼睛形状和间距

• 风格化

• 轮廓

• 材料和服装设计
如果角色戴着巴拉克拉瓦帽、面具、头盔或面部被遮盖，漫画画格中不得虚构面部解剖结构。
不要添加鼻子。

不要添加嘴巴。

参考图像中未显示皮肤的地方，不要露出皮肤。
漫画画格必须描绘与角色完全相同的设计语言，只是以印刷漫画艺术的形式呈现。
不要将角色拟人化。

不要重新诠释解剖结构。
主体与动作
迷你角色在页面上奔跑，仿佛正在穿越自己的故事。
巨大的漫画画格环绕着角色，每个画格都以大胆的漫画风格描绘着同一角色的动态动作姿势。

相机与视角
低角度微距特写镜头，相机几乎位于页面水平。
使用 90–100mm 微距镜头拍摄，赋予微小角色英雄般的尺度感。
角色略微偏离中心，身体前倾，处于运动状态。

景深
景深极浅。
奔跑中的迷你角色和漫画页面的即时部分清晰锐利。
周围的画格和远处的页面边缘则柔和模糊。

灯光
来自左上角的锐利电影式定向光，在漫画页面上投下戏剧性的阴影，并在光泽的印刷表面上产生细微的闪光。

环境与表面细节
印刷漫画页面的微观细节：
墨水纹理

纸张纤维

微妙的光泽反射
色彩分级
丰富饱和的漫画色彩，带有温暖的电影高光和柔和的环境光。
富有情调的微距摄影氛围。

渲染风格
逼真的微距玩具摄影美学，强调微小角色与巨大漫画书世界之间的尺度错觉。
长宽比 5:4

Create an exaggerated stylized 3D caricature character portrait with strong intentional deformation and a clean, controlled surface finish. Use the person from reference photo.Preserve the subject’s identity, facial likeness, skin tone, and defining features, but reinterpret them into a bold caricatured 3D form with an elongated neck, oversized head-to-neck ratio, droopy eyelids, heavy lips, and slightly asymmetrical facial structure.Render as a human-like 3D character with smooth, studio-clean skin and intentionally designed detail, avoiding random texture or noise. Style with bold accessories such as round or oval glasses, hoop earrings, gold chains, headscarves or bandanas, and street-luxury clothing.

Use neutral studio lighting with soft shadows and even illumination, no dramatic contrast, against a plain neutral grey or off-white background. The overall aesthetic should feel weird, fashion-forward, collectible, and character-driven rather than cute or realistic.

Ultra high definition, premium cinematic 3D render quality, hyper-realistic hyper realism, clean materials, no freckles, no dirt, no grain, no noise, no speckling, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

Aspect ratio 4:5.

使用中性工作室灯光，柔和的阴影和均匀的照明，没有戏剧性的对比，背景为纯中性灰色或米白色。整体美学应感觉怪异、时尚前卫、具有收藏价值且以角色为导向，而非可爱或写实。

title: 工业设计概念提示
description: 一个复杂的多步骤提示模板，用于在纯白色背景上生成一个高级工业设计概念，重点关注建筑几何、材料表面处理、品牌整合和人机交互元素。
content:
[BRAND NAME]: The core identity.

[CATEGORY]: Clothing / Food / Automotive / Lifestyle.

Goal: Generate a premium industrial design concept on a PURE WHITE background. 

1. INNOVATION & OBJECT

- Select one mundane functional object from [CATEGORY].

- Redesign it using unconventional, architectural, or origami-inspired geometry.

- The object must look like a high-end designer invention, not a standard product.

2. UNIFIED COMPOSITION

- Environment: A seamless, pure white studio background with a flat white floor.

- Interaction: A human hand (natural texture) is shown using the object in the foreground, demonstrating its unique ergonomics.

- Static Display: Right next to the hand, the same object is placed in a static, perfect pose to show its full silhouette and branding.

- Shadows: Soft, realistic grey drop shadows on the white floor to provide depth and ground the objects.

3. BRANDING & TEXT

- Identity: Apply the "{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}" logo in a high-contrast dark color (Black or Navy) directly onto the object's surface.

- Technical Detail: Add small, elegant blocks of justified "specification text" in the white negative space around the objects for an editorial look.

- Pattern: Use a subtle, oversized abstract fragment of the brand's logo as a texture on the object's material.

4. MATERIALS & FINISH

- High-quality matte materials only: heavy-duty recycled paper, sandblasted metal, or soft-touch polymer.

- Sharp architectural lines and clean, premium craftsmanship.
translatedContent:
[BRAND NAME]：核心识别。

[CATEGORY]：服装 / 食品 / 汽车 / 生活方式。

目标：在纯白色背景上生成一个高端工业设计概念。

1. 创新与物体

- 从 [CATEGORY] 中选择一个普通的实用物品。

- 运用非传统、建筑风格或折纸启发式的几何形状对其进行重新设计。

- 该物品必须看起来像一个高端设计师的发明，而非标准产品。

2. 统一构图

- 环境：无缝、纯白色的工作室背景，配有平坦的白色地板。

- 互动：一只人手（自然纹理）在前景中展示如何使用该物品，以体现其独特的人体工程学设计。

- 静态展示：在手旁边，将同一物品以静态、完美的姿态放置，以展示其完整的轮廓和品牌标识。

- 阴影：白色地板上柔和、逼真的灰色投影，以提供深度并使物体有落地感。

3. 品牌与文字

- 标识：将“{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}”标志以高对比度的深色（黑色或海军蓝）直接应用于物体表面。

- 技术细节：在物体周围的白色留白区域添加小巧、雅致的“规格说明文字”块，使其两端对齐，营造出编辑排版感。

- 图案：使用品牌标志的微妙、超大抽象碎片作为物体材料的纹理。

4. 材料与表面处理

- 仅限高品质哑光材料：重磅再生纸、喷砂金属或软触感聚合物。

- 锐利的建筑线条和干净、优质的工艺。

title: Vlog 风格时尚视频提示，适用于 Nano Banana Pro 和 Google Veo 3.1
description: 一个详细的提示，首先用于 Nano Banana Pro 生成图像，然后用于 Google Veo 3.1 生成视频。该提示描述了一个电影般的、逼真的、高质量的视频，在室内夜间拍摄，重点是一位面带温柔微笑的女性，她正准备开始录制 Vlog，讨论她的时尚要点。该提示包括具体的摄像机角度、灯光、氛围和对话。
content:
正面を向いた動画風のショットを作成。カメラは顔の高さで固定、被写体の真正面に配置。被写体は姿勢と構図から座っていることが示されている。

構図はシンプルで安定しており、劇的なアングルや目立つカメラの動きはない。照明は[UGCスタイルのショットを考慮した現実的な照明を追加]から。顔ははっきり見える。

被写体の表情は穏やかでリラックスしており、自然なほのかな微笑みを浮かべている。まるでカメラに向かってVlogを語り始めようとしているかのようだ。画質は夜間の屋内で撮影された動画（高画質）を反映しており、フィルター、美化効果、人工的なシャープネス処理は一切施されていない。

空間は個人的な空間として感じられる。ボケはカメラの限界によるもので、人工的な被写界深度効果ではない。全体的な雰囲気は温かく、明るく、親密で、被写体が話し始める直前のリアルなVlogの瞬間を思わせる。

女性のセリフは、「今日のファッションは【ファッションの特徴を追加】がポイントです！」と優しい口調で話しながら服を触っている。最後に笑顔になる。

BGM：Vlog風のファッションの雰囲気に合った音が心地よく流れている。
translatedContent:
创建一个正对镜头的视频风格镜头。摄像机固定在与面部齐平的高度，并直接放置在拍摄对象前方。拍摄对象的姿势和构图表明她正坐着。

构图简洁稳定，没有戏剧性的角度或明显的摄像机移动。灯光真实，符合 UGC（用户生成内容）风格的拍摄。面部清晰可见。

拍摄对象的表情平静放松，带着自然而浅淡的微笑，仿佛她正要开始一段面向镜头的 VLOG。图像质量反映了室内夜间拍摄的高质量视频，没有应用滤镜、美颜效果或人工锐化。

空间感觉很私密。背景虚化是由于摄像机本身的限制，而非人工景深效果。整体氛围温暖、明亮、亲密，让人联想到拍摄对象即将开始讲话前真实的 VLOG 瞬间。

女子的台词是：“今天时尚的亮点是 [添加时尚特色]！”她用温柔的语气说着，同时轻抚着自己的衣服。说完后她微笑了。

背景音乐：播放着与 VLOG 风格时尚视频氛围相符的悦耳音乐，音量轻柔。

content: [WHAT_IT_IS] Commerce/editorial product image. Monochrome studio study of a skincare bottle held between two hands with pronounced multi-frame motion blur for kinetic, airy minimalism. [SUBJECT_SCENE] Two hands occupy the frame on a pale seamless background, positioned diagonally: the upper hand enters from the right holding a small cylindrical pump bottle near the top-left quadrant, while a second hand below reaches upward from the lower-left, fingers open as if about to receive the product. The bottle is angled slightly downward-left, label side facing camera, with a matte body and a reflective metallic pump/collar that catches bright highlights. The hands are rendered with visible multi-exposure ghosting--each hand shows several offset silhouettes trailing along the direction of motion, especially around fingertips, creating a layered flutter effect. The bottle remains comparatively stable and readable, acting as the sharp anchor amid the blur, though its edges show slight softness consistent with motion. Composition is sparse and balanced: large negative space surrounds the central hand/product cluster, and the diagonal hand positions create a gentle "handoff" narrative. Focus is shallow-to-moderate but controlled so the product stays the visual priority while the ghosting conveys movement rather than defocus. [BACKGROUND] Clean pale gray/white seamless with no horizon line, reading as a minimal studio field. [LIGHTING_EFFECTS] Bright, diffused high-key lighting produces smooth tonal gradients on skin and the bottle body, with minimal harsh shadow edges. The metallic pump reflects a tight highlight band, indicating a slightly harder specular component within an otherwise soft setup. Motion effects read as long-exposure or composited frame trails: semi-transparent duplicates of the hands stack with decreasing opacity, creating soft-edged blur that is most intense at the fingertips and less pronounced near the wrists. Shadows are faint and washed, suggesting strong fill and a background pushed toward white; any contact shadowing is reduced to soft gray haze beneath the hands. The overall contrast is moderate, with skin texture subtly visible but simplified by the monochrome treatment and diffusion. No heavy bloom; instead the "airiness" comes from high-key exposure and the layered motion trails. translatedContent: 一部由四个镜头组成的电影短片，描绘了一位女性吃甜点时的魅力。影片采用暖色调和浅景深，并优先考虑 ASMR 般的音效设计。镜头无缝衔接，从特写双手打开包装，到中景捕捉她吃甜点时精致的表情和咀嚼声，包括捕捉散落的粉末和质感的慢动作镜头，最后到品尝完最后一口后的满足余韵。通过视觉和听觉两种方式，表达“美味”和“幸福”。

男士随意地倚靠在光滑的白色阳台栏杆上，栏杆上饰有现代几何镂空图案。他的姿态自然而自信。左手插在裤袋里，右臂舒适地搭在栏杆顶部。他的身体略微面向镜头，营造出一种轻松的生活方式肖像感。

环境暗示着这是一栋现代高档住宅楼或豪华公寓的阳台，栏杆外视野开阔。柔和的金***光照亮了整个场景，在白色建筑上投下柔和的高光，并在人物的衣物上呈现出温暖的色调。灯光营造出柔和的阴影和宁静的氛围。

She has long blonde hair with a natural wavy texture, parted slightly to the left and falling over her shoulders. She has fair skin with natural texture and a subtle flush on the cheeks. She has naturally shaped filled blonde eyebrows, a straight well-proportioned nose, and full naturally pink lips with a subtle clear gloss or balm. Her facial expression is confident and neutral. She is making a thumbs-up gesture with her right hand.

She is standing slightly angled toward the mirror, holding her phone in her left hand to take the selfie, while her right arm is raised with the thumb extended in a thumbs-up gesture.

She is wearing a pastel yellow strapless bandeau-style tube top made of soft stretchy cotton fabric. She is wearing light beige or khaki denim jeans that are loose, unbuttoned and slightly unzipped at the waist. A plain white thong waistband is clearly visible above the unbuttoned jeans.

She is holding an iPhone with three camera lenses in a pink and white gingham plaid patterned phone case. She is wearing a delicate gold chain necklace with a small pendant, layered bracelets on her left wrist including a red beaded bracelet and other small charm bracelets, small stud earrings, and short fingernails with a light pink gel manicure.

The mirror reflection shows a well-lit bedroom. On the left side a white wardrobe cabinet is partially visible. In the background there is a bed with white linens and a pale pink throw blanket. Behind the bed is a window with partially closed white horizontal blinds. On the windowsill there are small decorative items including a small pink flower pot and some seashells. A white radiator is visible below the window. The flooring is light wood laminate. The edge of a white framed mirror is visible on the left side of the image.

Photography style: candid mirror selfie, natural daylight from the window evenly lighting the room, sharp focus on the subject’s face and reflection, medium close-up composition, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, realistic unaltered phone camera aesthetic with natural film grain.
translatedContent:
一张在白天光线充足的卧室里拍摄的真实、自然的镜子自拍照。画面中，一位年轻的成年女性从腰部以上入镜，她正对着镜子中的自己，用手机拍照。整体氛围休闲而自信。

她留着一头自然波浪状的金色长发，略微偏向左侧，披散在肩上。她的皮肤白皙，带有自然的纹理，脸颊上泛着淡淡的红晕。她蓝绿色的眼睛直视镜头，表情自然。她的眉毛是自然修饰过的金色，鼻梁挺直匀称，嘴唇丰满，呈自然的粉红色，涂有淡淡的透明唇彩或润唇膏。她的面部表情自信而平静。她右手比划着竖起大拇指的手势。

description: 一个详细的提示，用于使用 Nano Banana Pro 生成图像，然后使用 Google Veo 3.1 制作视频。该提示描述了一个稳定、固定机位的女性镜头，用于营造真实、亲密的视频博客时刻，重点是自然光线、放松的表情和特定的对话。
content:
正面を向いた動画風のショットを作成。カメラは顔の高さで固定、被写体の真正面に配置。被写体は姿勢と構図から座っていることが示されている。

構図はシンプルで安定しており、劇的なアングルや目立つカメラの動きはない。照明は[UGCスタイルのショットを考慮した現実的な照明を追加]から。顔ははっきり見える。

被写体の表情は穏やかでリラックスしており、自然なほのかな微笑みを浮かべている。まるでカメラに向かってVlogを語り始めようとしているかのようだ。画質は夜間の屋内で撮影された動画（高画質）を反映しており、フィルター、美化効果、人工的なシャープネス処理は一切施されていない。

空間は個人的な空間として感じられる。ボケはカメラの限界によるもので、人工的な被写界深度効果ではない。全体的な雰囲気は温かく、明るく、親密で、被写体が話し始める直前のリアルなVlogの瞬間を思わせる。

女性のセリフは、「今日のファッションは【ファッションの特徴を追加】がポイントです！」と優しい口調で話しながら服を触っている。最後に笑顔になる。

BGM：Vlog風のファッションの雰囲気に合った音が心地よく流れている。

创建一个面向前方的视频风格镜头。摄像机固定在与面部齐平的高度，并直接位于拍摄对象前方。根据姿势和构图，拍摄对象被指示为坐姿。

构图简洁稳定，没有戏剧性的角度或明显的摄像机移动。光线是 [添加考虑 UGC 风格镜头的真实光线]。面部清晰可见。

拍摄对象的表情平静放松，带着自然、淡淡的微笑。她看起来像是即将开始对着镜头为 Vlog 讲话。图像质量反映了室内夜间拍摄的高质量视频，没有应用滤镜、美颜效果或人工锐化。

空间感觉很私密。散景是由于摄像机的限制，而不是人工景深效果。整体氛围温暖、明亮、亲密，让人联想到拍摄对象即将开始讲话前真实的 Vlog 时刻。

这位女士的台词是：“今天时尚的亮点是 [添加时尚特色]！”她用温柔的语气说着，同时触摸着自己的衣服。最后她笑了。

content:
A highly realistic cinematic photograph of a young man standing alone on a quiet countryside road during the spring season in daytime. The narrow paved road stretches into the distance, surrounded by lush green fields and rows of trees on both sides. The trees are filled with fresh green leaves and soft blossoms, with a few petals scattered along the roadside and gently drifting in the breeze. title: Vlog 风格时尚视频提示，适用于 Nano Banana Pro 图像生成
description: 以下是 Nano Banana Pro 生成图像所使用的详细提示，该图像随后使用 Google Veo 3.1 转换为视频。该提示着重于创建一个真实、亲密、温馨的女性 vlog 风格镜头，她正在讨论自己的时尚，强调自然光线、微妙的表情和高质量的视频反射。
content:
正面を向いた動画風のショットを作成。カメラは顔の高さで固定、被写体の真正面に配置。被写体は姿勢と構図から座っていることが示されている。

構図はシンプルで安定しており、劇的なアングルや目立つカメラの動きはない。照明は[UGCスタイルのショットを考慮した現実的な照明を追加]から。顔ははっきり見える。

被写体の表情は穏やかでリラックスしており、自然なほのかな微笑みを浮かべている。まるでカメラに向かってVlogを語り始めようとしているかのようだ。画質は夜間の屋内で撮影された動画（高画質）を反映しており、フィルター、美化効果、人工的なシャープネス処理は一切施されていない。

空間は個人的な空間として感じられる。ボケはカメラの限界によるもので、人工的な被写界深度効果ではない。全体的な雰囲気は温かく、明るく、親密で、被写体が話し始める直前のリアルなVlogの瞬間を思わせる。

女性のセリフは、「今日のファッションは【ファッションの特徴を追加】がポイントです！」と優しい口調で話しながら服を触っている。最後に笑顔になる。

BGM：Vlog風のファッションの雰囲気に合った音が心地よく流れている。
translatedContent:
创建一个正对镜头的视频风格镜头。摄像机固定在与面部齐平的高度，并直接位于拍摄对象前方。根据拍摄对象的姿势和构图，表明其处于坐姿。

构图简洁稳定，没有夸张的角度或明显的摄像机移动。光线来自 [添加符合 UGC 风格镜头的真实光照]。面部清晰可见。

拍摄对象的表情平静放松，带着自然、微妙的微笑。看起来她正要对着镜头开始为 Vlog 讲话。图像质量反映了室内夜间拍摄的视频（高质量），没有应用滤镜、美颜效果或人工锐化。

空间感觉很私密。散景是由于摄像机的限制，而非人工景深效果。整体氛围温暖、明亮、亲密，让人联想到拍摄对象即将开始讲话前真实的 Vlog 时刻。

这位女士的台词是：“今天时尚的亮点是 [添加时尚特色]！”她轻柔地说着，同时触摸着自己的衣服。最后她笑了。

背景音乐：轻柔播放着适合 Vlog 风格时尚氛围的舒适音乐。
